October 21, 2026

France has erupted in violent riots, and the main reason is France allowed third world immigrants to invade their country. Charles the Hammer, who stopped the Muslim invasion of Europe in 732 at the [Battle of Tours](https://substack.com/redirect/6091173c-c16f-4483-9c75-d9de6dede561?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), must be rolling over in his grave.

What reportedly started as [protests against unfunded schools](https://substack.com/redirect/34274c68-df33-4906-9830-f18c5afe72c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) quickly escalated into riots in which shops, churches, government buildings and streets were engulfed in flames in the major cities of Paris, Marseille and Lyon. In Limoges, a government building that survived a Nazi assault was set ablaze. The Louvre was even closed. Immigrants have never assimilated and saw this opportunity to destroy the country they despise.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1bb346a6-e5e4-4baf-afcf-ce104cb6f4ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A Street Burning in France

There is even talk about cancelling the Steeler Saints game this Sunday near Paris, although some Steeler fans are suggesting that rioters be recruited for our feckless secondary if we can get around the rule banning players from wrapping keffiyehs around their helmets.

But the French political class is even worse than the Steeler secondary. Prime Minister Macron is handling the situation with characteristic spinelessness by [fleeing the country](https://substack.com/redirect/1de8d879-268a-4395-9f1c-9e7b6a11f3c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to tour the Middle East. Police officers are fleeing for fear of their lives fully aware that if they take the appropriate steps to end the violence, they will be imprisoned and stripped of their pensions. Arrests have been made, but everyone knows that little will be done to these violent thugs.

But why is this happening? Because the French have gotten exactly what they voted for. They listened to the Eurozone's leaders in Brussels who preached about the wonders of diversity. They were made to feel guilty about France's colonial past. They were told they had an obligation to allow those from the downtrodden third world to enter France and receive free housing, food and medical care to atone for past sins.

But as Margaret Thatcher famously said, "The problem with socialism is that you eventually run out of other people's money."

And that is exactly what happened. France can no longer afford to fund a huge social welfare network for its citizens and new immigrants while keeping its education system intact. The schools are infested with mold, and teachers are frequently nowhere to be found.

France now has the second highest welfare spending in Europe and the gap in tax revenues and government spending has widened so much that the interest rates on [French bonds have increased](https://substack.com/redirect/ac1545b8-899a-410c-aa4e-f69229e0ce39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), meaning the French taxpayers have to pay more money to service this debt. Look for cries for an American taxpayer bailout of these bonds soon.

How will this end? Who knows? The anti-immigrant conservative Marine Le Pen is on track to become Prime Minister, but the French ruling class is trying to keep her off the ballot. And even if she wins, it will be difficult to mollify the violent immigrants without busting heads.

But one thing is for sure. If the Democrats ever seize power, this will happen in the United States.
Under the Biden administration, America's borders were open and at least 10,000,000 illegals streamed into the country. When Republicans criticized this policy and introduced resolution against this in 2024, the Democrats [overwhelmingly voted ](https://substack.com/redirect/43c17f98-fdbb-4f42-8819-2e3eda07006a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)to allow this invasion to continue.

The Democratic base agrees with the French ruling class. They despise America and believe we are a country of racist, sexist, homophobic colonialists who owe the third world a living. Should the Democrats seize both the House and the Senate along with the Presidency in 2028, the borders will reopen and the invasion will begin again.

The only reason that hasn't happened is that the American people voted for President Trump - warts and all - to stop this invasion. And President Trump has obliged and our border is sealed. But Democrats are fighting tooth-and-nail to prevent President Trump from deporting those in the country illegally, attacking ICE agents while Democratic politicians, such as those in my home state of Connecticut, release violent thugs who continue to maim the population. One illegal immigrant who was not turned over to ICE for deportation killed a two-year-old toddler by bashing his head in and stuffing his body in a plastic bag. The Democrats just turned their heads.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0ed9ae2b-8279-497f-8da9-feae2d097e95?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

But President Trump's incompetence has made him highly unpopular if polls are to be believed. He instituted tariffs that increased inflation. He then started an ill-conceived war with Iran that appears impossible to win without the use of ground troops or nuclear weapons. Gas prices skyrocketed along with diesel fuel, which powers the trucks that deliver our food. Inflation became worse. To make matters worse, he agreed to buy diesel fuel from the ruthless thug Vladimir Putin after criticizing Europe for doing the same.
This puts the Democrats in the catbird seat to take the House and Senate in two weeks and then the Presidency in 2028.

Optimistic readers may feel this won't happen. But nobody lies better or rigs elections better than the Democrats. The Democratic presidential nominee will pretend to be a moderate. And then after the election is won, the borders will open and illegals will reinvade the country again. And these illegals will demand free housing, medical care and food, and they will riot if they don't get it - or even if they do.

name: True the Vote
subject: What I saw in the ER last night
body:
We’re okay. But I can’t stop thinking about the people in that waiting room.
| | | October 21, 2026 | [**Read Online**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/e5uzom7wqph7hlx8k9lc8h88d2l33alh0g46q/48hvhehm3n032vixh7/aHR0cHM6Ly9ja2FyY2hpdmUuY29tL2IvMzh1cGhraDJ3ZXE2MnUzN3h4bDc1ZjQ0N252ZDhhN2h6eGczbQ==) |
---

Hi Friend,
Last night I took my son to the ER.
We’re okay now. But we were there for more than eight hours, and what I saw in that local hospital stayed with me.
Part of it was just being in a children’s ER. Watching kids hurt and parents frightened is hard. But that wasn’t all of it. Looking around that waiting room, I realized I was surrounded by the very people we’re fighting for: the underprivileged and the undersupported, the families who have been made promise after promise by a system that keeps failing them.
These are the people big government says it’s protecting. Too often, it’s the people big government takes advantage of. For far too long it has kept them dependent and overlooked, and kept telling them their voice doesn’t matter.
Many of them don’t know it’s happening. They’re tired. They’re working, waiting, and holding their families together. They have no time to read the fine print or follow the headlines. They’ve been told for so long that the system will take care of them that they’ve stopped expecting anything else.
I sat there holding my son, and I felt two things at once.
The first was heartbreak. If you stop and actually see what’s going on around us, it breaks your heart.
The second was anger. I wasn’t angry at the people in that room. I was angry for them. These families were promised so much and given so little, and the system that made those promises is still counting on them to stay home, stay quiet, and stay tired.
But every strong emotion carries a signal. Heartbreak tells you what matters. Anger tells you something is wrong and needs to change. You can act on it, or you can let it pass.
I don’t want to let it pass.
Over the next two weeks, you’ll hear plenty of noise. Over the next two weeks, it will be increasingly more difficult to hold on to our compassion. The polls will swing back and forth, because drama is built into how polling works. The headlines will pile on one crisis after another, and much of it will seem designed to make ordinary people feel like showing up won’t matter.
Don’t believe it.
When you invest in [Mobilize A Million](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/e5uzom7wqph7hlx8k9lc8h88d2l33alh0g46q/wnh2hghqd3rdo7a7hx/aHR0cHM6Ly9tb2JpbGl6ZWFtaWxsaW9uLm9yZy8=), you’re investing in the little guy. You’re investing in the mom in that waiting room who has been let down again and again and doesn’t know her vote is just as powerful as anyone’s. You’re investing in the dad working a double shift who never got a reminder to check his registration. You’re investing in the families who have stopped believing anyone is looking out for them.
That’s who this is for. It isn’t for politicians or pundits. It’s for the people in the waiting room.
Election Day is November 3. Until then, our team is working to make sure everyday citizens know their registration is accurate, know where and how to vote, and know their voice counts.
[**Check your registration and send it to three people you love →**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/e5uzom7wqph7hlx8k9lc8h88d2l33alh0g46q/08hwh9h24km475alh5/aHR0cHM6Ly9zY2FuY2hlY2twcm90ZWN0Lm9yZy8=)
[**Stand with the little guy. Give today →**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/e5uzom7wqph7hlx8k9lc8h88d2l33alh0g46q/wnh2hghqd3rdo7a7hx/aHR0cHM6Ly9tb2JpbGl6ZWFtaWxsaW9uLm9yZy8=)
I left that hospital exhausted and grateful my son is okay. I was still a little heartbroken and still a little angry. I’ve decided to put both feelings to work. The people who have been failed the longest deserve to be seen, counted, and heard.
Let’s not fail them now.
For Freedom,
Sarah

body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=241140%2E444211%2EyJjP5s)
I spent the first two days of early voting rallying with Bernie Sanders and Greg Casar in El Paso and Houston.
Here’s why I’m hopeful:
People are voting. In El Paso, we surpassed both 2018 and 2022 in total ballots cast on the first day of early voting. In Harris County, more than 100,000 votes were cast on day one, shattering the previous record of 63,188 set in 2018. People are doing the work.
Greg and Bernie met some of the thousands of Powered by People volunteers who’ve been meeting young Texans, getting them registered, and personally staying in touch. It’s the work that works – and it helps explain the numbers we’re seeing.
Bernie was as clear and strong as I’ve ever seen him: money is not speech, corporations are not people, and this government belongs to all of us, not just the wealthiest.
And none of this would have been possible without Greg Casar, who brought the passion and energy that packed the Abraham Chavez Theater in El Paso and Wheeler Baptist Church in Houston’s Third Ward.
[**Chip in to help Powered by People keep pushing, full gas, all the way to November 3rd.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20261021.eknRwB&refcode=ema20261021-241140&t=3&akid=241140%2E444211%2EyJjP5s)
Thank you,
Beto

body:

Peter, as Election Day looms closer, I have an urgent message for you:
**Early voting is starting TOMORROW** -- and we have to reach voters now as they prepare to cast their ballots.
The top thing I want people to know is: **Maryland is not a safe blue state.** Two of the last four governors before me were Republicans. Just four years ago, we had a Republican governor.
We need to make sure voters know that it’s crucial that all of us show up. We need everyone to cast their ballots and make their voices heard.
**We can’t give this race anything less than our all.[If you’re with me, will you rush a contribution to our re-election campaign so we can reach voters right now?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261021-1.b1ttRL&refcode=em-20261021-1&t=2&akid=2157%2E1086043%2EYUeuAh)**

My opponent Dan Cox is a MAGA extremist who backed the effort to overturn the 2020 election. He wants to hand this state back to Trump on a silver platter, and if we don’t show up in November, this could happen.
We've spent three years delivering for Maryland. We’ve proven what’s possible when you have a governor who actually shows up. **_Dan Cox would reverse every bit of our progress._**

clean_body: Peter, as Election Day looms closer, I have an urgent message for you: Early voting is starting TOMORROW -- and we have to reach voters now as they prepare to cast their ballots. The top thing I want people to know is: Maryland is not a safe blue state. Two of the last four governors before me were Republicans. Just four years ago, we had a Republican governor. We need to make sure voters know that it’s crucial that all of us show up. We need everyone to cast their ballots and make their voices heard. We can’t give this race anything less than our all. My opponent Dan Cox is a MAGA extremist who backed the effort to overturn the 2020 election. He wants to hand this state back to Trump on a silver platter, and if we don’t show up in November, this could happen. We've spent three years delivering for Maryland. We’ve proven what’s possible when you have a governor who actually shows up. Dan Cox would reverse every bit of our progress. Elevate, Wes

Peter -Early voting is officially underway in Nevada, and I have one message for you: **We cannot afford to sit this election out. **Between now and Election Day on November 3, Nevadans will make decisions that will shape the future of our state for years to come. Every statewide constitutional office is on the ballot. Our congressional races are critically important. And Democrats are fighting to gain supermajorities in both the Nevada State Senate and Assembly.**THE STAKES COULDN’T BE ANY HIGHER.**
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/5lPmWdtGZtZ?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d)
| | | | | | | | | | | |
And here's what I really want you to understand: **These races are CLOSE. **
We've seen Nevada elections decided by razor-thin margins. **Some races are won or lost by less than 1% of the vote.** That means your vote—and the votes of your friends, family, coworkers, and neighbors—could literally be the difference between winning and losing.
So I'm asking you to do more than just cast your ballot.
**SHOW UP. BRING SOMEONE WITH YOU. SPREAD THE WORD.**
Talk to your neighbors. Remind your coworkers. Call a friend who doesn't always vote in midterm elections. Make sure the people around you understand just how much is on the line.
**And that every single vote counts.**
---
| | | | | | | | | | [|

## The Energy Across Nevada is Incredible!
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
I had the opportunity to kick off early voting this weekend alongside **Governor Joe Lombardo,** campaigning across Northern Nevada with stops in Carson City, Reno, and Douglas County.
One of the highlights was speaking at the**Douglas County Republican Party's Heritage BBQ in Gardnerville.** What a fantastic crowd!
Everywhere I travel, I meet Nevadans who are energized, engaged, and fighting to prevent California ideas from taking over Nevada.
I'm especially grateful for the overwhelming support from Nevadans who believe, as I do, that the State Treasurer's Office should be a place of transparency, accountability, and fiscal responsibility.
**Your money deserves a watchdog!**
But here's the thing: **All the enthusiasm in the world won't matter if we don't turn it into votes.**
We've worked too hard, and there's simply too much at stake, to leave anything to chance.
---
| |

## Make Your Plan to Vote
---
| |
**Early Voting: October 17–30****Election Day: Tuesday, November 3**
Please don't wait until the last minute. Vote early, encourage others to do the same, and help us carry this momentum all the way through Election Day.
I'm incredibly optimistic about what we can accomplish together. But winning requires every one of us to do our part.
**Let's finish strong. Let's get out the vote. And let's win this for Nevada!**
Thank you for standing with me,Drew

I've been in politics for twenty years, and I've never seen a campaign do something this low.
In the Ohio governor's race, Republican Vivek Ramaswamy has launched, maybe, the most disgusting ad I've ever seen against the Democrat, Amy Acton. To understand just how sick it is, you need to know Amy's story.
When Amy was 12, she was taken away from her parents because the man married to her mother raped her. Her mother stayed married to that man until the day he died, and Amy has been estranged from her ever since. Amy has spoken openly about this for years. She has bravely shared her story to help others who may see themselves in her.
And Vivek Ramaswamy chose to weaponize her story. His campaign put Amy's mother, a mother who stayed with the man who raped her daughter, in a campaign ad attacking her. She looked straight into the camera and called her own daughter a liar, over and over again. And now Ramaswamy is spending $4 million to make sure every voter in Ohio sees it.
There's no other way to say it. This is undeniably disgusting.
Let's be clear about why Ramaswamy is doing this. He's desperate. Amy Acton is favored to be the next governor of Ohio. The state is slipping away from Republicans, mostly because of the economy, but also because they continue to elevate second-rate candidates that are totally undeserving of political power in America.
* * *
**Today 's rant is sponsored by Ground News.**
_Writing Endless Urgency means figuring out what 's actually happening in politics, not just what's trending. And the hardest part isn't finding the news. It's figuring out what I'm not being shown._
_That 's where Ground News comes in. It pulls together 50,000+ news sources so I can see how every story is covered across the political spectrum, plus each outlet's bias, reliability, and who owns it._
_The tool I lean on most is the Blindspot Feed, which flags stories one side is barely covering. Take the one below: 39 outlets reported that Republicans are spending $1 billion on the midterms while costs rise. Only 5 lean right. That 's the kind of gap that shapes what millions of voters think is real, and it's exactly what we try to call out here._
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2600ff63-b864-41bd-a37a-a82b7ac53555?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

_**Get 40% off their unlimited access Vantage Plan with my link:[groundnews.com/mikenellis](https://substack.com/redirect/b2ec2bed-2020-4dbe-851f-dc89d9a35679?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ->**_
[Subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/4b7aee63-59fe-408c-9f08-83e571f34397?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
But desperation is no excuse. Putting the estranged mother of a gubernatorial candidate on TV to call a rape survivor a liar does nothing to help you win an election. It does nothing to help the people of Ohio. It only exposes you as the monster that you are. Forget being a failed leader. You do something like that, you're a failed human being.
It's truly remarkable to me how far the Republican Party has fallen. It needs to be burned to the ground and the earth salted, never to come back again. And this isn't just Donald Trump. There are thousands of people who work inside the Republican Party who are comfortable with stuff like this, and who are cheering it on.
It's fitting that this is happening in Ohio, which has been, in my opinion, the epicenter of moral decay inside the Republican Party. Look at Congressman Max Miller, who is basically Donald Trump's protege. He's been credibly accused of beating his ex-wife and breaking his daughter's collarbone. They should have ditched his ass a long time ago. But because Donald Trump is a scumbag who supports and surrounds himself with abusers, not only is Miller running for re-election, national Republicans are spending millions and millions of dollars to defend him, hoping partisanship will save this man's career.
Now look, the Democratic Party is not perfect. But when it became clear who Graham Platner was, we ditched his ass. When Eric Swalwell was on his way to becoming the next governor of California and it became clear he was credibly accused of being a serial abuser, we dumped his ass. Not only that, we made him resign from Congress.
Meanwhile, Max Miller gets to keep his job. So do so many Republicans who act dishonorably and dangerously toward women.
* * *
**Quick break: this rant is brought to you by Ground News.**
_A lot of what we write about at Endless Urgency starts with a simple question: who isn 't covering this? Ground News' Blindspot Feed is how my team and I find out._
**[See what your feed is missing. Get 40% off->](https://substack.com/redirect/2600ff63-b864-41bd-a37a-a82b7ac53555?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/4b7aee63-59fe-408c-9f08-83e571f34397?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
At what point as a nation are we going to stand up and say this is not okay? I swear to God, we have got to reach a point where the American people stand up and say no to this scumbaggery.
It is incumbent upon all of us, especially men like me, to speak out. To make sure the men in our lives know it is not okay to do these things. It is not okay to uplift or revere these actions.**It is not okay to not protect women.**
Real men protect and defend the people they love. That includes women. And it includes kids.
It doesn't matter whether it's Ramaswamy's campaign going after Amy Acton, the Trump family cozying up to the Tate brothers, or the ongoing cover-up of the Epstein files. I could name you a thousand more. This shit needs to stop.
I've said it before: I badly want the theme of the 2026 midterms to be a rejection of scumbags in American politics. No Graham Platners. No Max Millers. No Ken Paxtons. No Vivek Ramaswamys. Get rid of all of them, Democrat or Republican.
We should be better than this as a country. We should be more involved than we are right now. But hopefully we can use this as an opportunity to boot some of these fuckers out of office, because every single one of them needs to go.
I doubt she'll read this, but I'm sending a lot of love to Amy Acton and her team right now. I can only imagine that the trauma she's been forced to relive is devastating for her and for the people around her, including the people who support her who are probably survivors, themselves.
God love you all.
With urgency,
--Mike

| | | | | |

Dear Fellow Arizonan–You don't have to agree on everything politically to agree that Washington needs to change.That's exactly why I'm excited to share my newest ad featuring Jane Lowery, a lifelong Democrat who is crossing party lines to support my campaign for Congress.Jane and I don't agree on every issue, and that's the point. She's looking beyond party labels because she knows Arizona deserves better than the same old Washington politics.I've spent my life serving patients, serving our country as a Navy officer, and running a small business where meeting payroll isn't optional. I know what it takes to solve problems and get results.That's what I'm fighting to bring to Congress. Banning congressional stock trading, strengthening national security, and bringing competition back to healthcare to lower costs for Arizona families. These aren't Republican or Democrat issues. They're commonsense priorities that Washington has ignored for far too long.Meanwhile, Greg Stanton has spent seven years in Congress voting in lockstep with his party, introducing dozens of bills with only ONE becoming law. Arizona families are still waiting for him to show up and actually solve something.Greg Stanton answers to his party. I answer to Arizona.People are tired of the political games, and supporters like Jane are proof that Arizonans are willing to look beyond party lines for real leadership.[WATCH MY NEW AD HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/14nQ6LWuoXf?e=6477bcd9cd&c2id=f05c70fe8231dcabc26816038b27d5aa)Let's put Arizona over politics and bring real results back to AZ-04!– Zuhdi
**Learn more at**[**Z4AZ.com**](https://us.list-manage.com/my2WfdiN_3f?e=6477bcd9cd&c2id=f05c70fe8231dcabc26816038b27d5aa)**.**

So today I’m asking you directly: Will you be one of the 39?

| | | The U.S. has officially hit a milestone we really didn’t want to hit: 4,000 identified cases of measles just this year. Most of those cases are among people aged 19 and younger, and what’s more _, around 95% of people who were infected with measles were unvaccinated_ or had unknown vaccination status.

This should be simple: the MMR vaccine saves lives. Just one dose is 93% effective against measles! But with vaccination rates plummeting, we’re now on track for the worst measles outbreak in a quarter of a century. Why aren’t people vaccinating their kids? Those values run deep in our history and in our people.But over time, the political establishment and a flood of left-wing ideas have overpowered the very values that made Colorado strong. name: KAREN CRNKOVICH FOR JOHNSON COUNTY COMMISSION
subject: You Asked, Here is My Answer
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY KAREN CRNKOVICH FOR JOHNSON COUNTY COMMISSION * 6709 West 119th Street * Ste
body:
| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/hQ0gZT1ILhw?e=7320325a61&c2id=7adf4106091b2bdf32986c5b36d3a494)
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/s2Hl9xFEsna?e=7320325a61&c2id=7adf4106091b2bdf32986c5b36d3a494)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

Friends,One question I hear repeatedly is:**“If you want property tax relief, where would you cut?”** Fair question.To remain revenue neutral for 2027, Johnson County would have needed to collect roughly **$19.8 million less in property taxes**. County officials themselves used that figure when discussing the Revenue Neutral Rate.So where would I start?**1\. Right-size our reserves.** Johnson County's 2027 budget includes approximately **$530 million in reserves**. Not all of that money is unrestricted or available to spend, and responsible reserves matter. The County says its unrestricted General Fund target is 28% and that strong reserves help protect its AAA bond rating.But responsible stewardship also means asking whether taxpayers are being asked to contribute more than necessary simply to continue building balances.I would review reserves **fund by fund** , protect restricted dollars and our credit rating, and determine whether we can responsibly right-size the amount taxpayers are being asked to maintain.**2\. Take a hard look at staffing.** Johnson County budgeted **4,136.48 FTEs in 2022. For 2027, that number is 4,426.88** , an increase of about 290 positions. Some of that growth reflects legitimate service demands, particularly in Health and Human Services.But every new position should still have to answer basic questions:Do we need it?
What measurable result will it produce?
Could the work be absorbed, automated, outsourced or reorganized?
And when a position becomes vacant, should it automatically be filled?I would not begin with frontline public safety or essential services. **I would begin with vacant positions, administrative growth and positions whose value to taxpayers cannot be clearly demonstrated.****3\. Demand more discipline on construction.** Before approving major capital projects, I want independent cost benchmarks, value engineering and real comparisons between **building new, renovating existing space, leasing and outsourcing.** A project shouldn't move forward simply because we “want it”. The question should be: **Are taxpayers getting the best value?****4\. Stop treating “nice to have” as “need to have.”** Consultants. Outside contracts. Pilot programs. Duplicative services. Projects that have expanded beyond their original purpose.None of these individually solves the entire problem.But government should have to do what families and businesses do every day:**Prioritize.** This isn't about taking a wrecking ball to the county government or budget. It is about going line by line and asking whether every expenditure is necessary, effective and delivering value.Property tax relief will require choices.I am willing to make them.Here is how you can help!Every $25, $50, $100, or $250 contribution helps us reach another voter, put another sign in the ground, boost another digital ad and make the case for a different direction in Johnson County.[**DONATE HERE**](https://us.list-manage.com/mo81NF76CAF?e=7320325a61&c2id=7adf4106091b2bdf32986c5b36d3a494) And money alone will not win this election.We are in the final stages of this race, and volunteers are more important than ever. Knock doors. Make calls. Put up signs. Talk to your neighbors.[**JOIN THE TEAM**](https://us.list-manage.com/7w39lxlqOZH?e=7320325a61&c2id=7adf4106091b2bdf32986c5b36d3a494) I promise to fight to bring about positive change and fiscal sanity. **Are you ready to join me?** Karen Crnkovich
Candidate for Johnson County Commission Chair

**Ivette DECODES**
**How are we accounting for the impact?**
The Department of Veterans Affairs approved $2.681 billion in infrastructure improvement projects during the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026. These projects are funded through its $4.8 billion annual non-recurring maintenance budget--the largest in the department's history. The VA says it obligated the entire $4.8 billion.
An obligation is not the same as a completed project, and a completed project is not proof of impact.
The project list spans 48 states, Washington, D.C., and Puerto Rico. It identifies planned work by facility and city, giving readers a way to find projects in their own communities.
Yet it does not provide a complete accounting of how much each facility will receive, how much has actually been spent, or which projects are finished.
The VA is responsible for accounting for this investment. Citizens have a responsibility to examine the record and hold officials accountable.
**How much is committed to each facility? What has been delivered? And what evidence shows veterans are better served?

You've heard Democrats talk about a "blue wave" this year. But what's really powering their Senate campaigns is a GREEN WAVE of cash. And it's crashing over the Senate map right now. Look at the latest FEC reports, covering July through September: ▶ **TEXAS** : James Talarico (D) raised $60.2 million. Ken Paxton (R) raised $10.2 million.
▶ **KANSAS** : Adam Hamilton (D) raised $9.4 million. Roger Marshall (R) raised $800,000.
▶ **GEORGIA** : Jon Ossoff (D) raised $33.1 million. Mike Collins (R) raised $2.8 million.
▶ **FLORIDA** : Angie Nixon (D) raised $7.2 million. Ashley Moody (R) raised $2.1 million.

You may have seen headlines bragging about record Republican super PAC money. The GOP's top Senate super PAC just raised a record $272.9 million in a single quarter. Here's what those headlines leave out: **a super PAC dollar doesn't go nearly as far as a candidate dollar.** Federal law requires TV and radio stations to sell ad time to candidates at their LOWEST UNIT RATE in the final 60 days before a general election. That's the same rate the station gives its best commercial customer. Super PACs don't get that rate. They pay whatever the station charges. During a football game in Austin in September, a Republican super PAC was charged $450,000 to air a single ad. Talarico's campaign paid $50,000 for a spot in the same game, in the same market. **That's NINE TIMES the price.**

That's why I would dearly love to see them lose their jobs.
**We have an election coming, and with it, the opportunity of a lifetime. Let's not waste it.**
Across the country, Democratic pro-choice women have stepped up to take on Republicans and fight for something better. They're shouldering the attacks that come with challenging billionaires and megadonors who are used to getting their way.
We need to help those women finish the job.
They need resources to reach voters, answer those attacks, and keep fighting through the very last day. In a close race, just one more conversation, one more voter reached, or one more person getting to the polls can make all the difference.

We want to win margins so decisive that the women we help elect will have a clear mandate to lead our country in a new direction and undo the disaster of the Trump years.

In a race this close, that 10% will decide who represents Hampton Roads, and which party controls the House. Our job in these final 13 days is to clear that fog. That means a volunteer on their doorstep, a call to their phone, and an ad that tells them the truth about who I am and what I’ve achieved for Hampton Roads. Case File No DRT-ED-WINDOW · Special File · The Early Window
Morgan Stanley Sees a $1 Trillion Market for Flying Vehicles by 2040. The Rules That Make It Possible Are Only Three Months Old.
On July 24, the FAA opened a path for personally owned electric aircraft for the first time. Analysts have projected that urban air mobility could become a trillion-dollar market within 15 years. Right now, before any company in this new category is certified or listed, the price of getting in is at its lowest.
Threat level 3/5 — Guarded
| | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
|
---
Every new transportation industry has a moment when the rules finally catch up with the technology. For cars, it was licensing and roads. For airlines, it was air traffic control. For small personal electric aircraft, that moment came this summer, and most people still haven’t noticed.
The evidence board
| | Why the Clock Started in July
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — the rule.** On July 24, 2026, the aircraft part of the FAA’s modernized light-sport rules took effect, making small, personally owned electric vertical-takeoff aircraft eligible for the category for the first time.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — the market.** Morgan Stanley has projected that urban air mobility could become a $1 trillion market by 2040.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit C — the contrast.** The big air-taxi companies are on a heavier certification path, with FAA type certificates not expected before mid-2027. The personal-aircraft route is lighter and aimed at individual owners.
| CHATTER
---
None of this is guaranteed. German air-taxi developer Lilium went insolvent in 2024, and every company in this field still faces a long, expensive path to production. That risk is exactly why early prices are low.
| OUR THEORY
---
In private offerings, the earliest price is usually the lowest one. As a company hits milestones, its share price tends to step up. For investors who believe in the category and understand the risks, timing can matter as much as the choice of company.
Connected file
| | Everything Electric Runs on the Grid
---|---
Electric aircraft, electric cars and AI data centers all compete for the same power. The EIA expects the average U.S. home electricity price to rise from 17.3 cents per kilowatt-hour in 2025 to 18.2 cents this year, and power bills have become a campaign issue heading into the November 3 midterms.
Some analysts think the fix won’t come from the public grid at all.

Just a few days ago, a group of Evergreen Members joined the Save the Redwoods team for a hike through Big Basin. subject: Abbott is underwater.
body:
We turned a long shot into a dead heat. Now we need to finish it.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
**A recent poll came out showing me ahead of Greg Abbott, 47% to 45%.**
That’s the sixth poll in the last month to show us leading this race. Not tied. Ahead.
If you’d told me a year ago, when we launched this campaign, that we’d be here, I’m not sure I would have believed you. But here we are, and it’s because of people like you.
[**So I’m asking: will you make your first-ever donation of $15 today to keep this momentum going?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261021_2_leading.lmYmKi&refcode=em20261021-2497&t=1&akid=2497%2E299639%2Es-SQCD)
Here’s what the numbers tell me:
Texans know Greg Abbott, and they’re tired of him. 52% of likely voters view him unfavorably, and only 44% favorably. **After more than a decade of corruption that’s left Texas families to fend for themselves, voters across the political spectrum are ready for change.**
And the more Texans get to know me, the more they like what they see. My name ID has jumped to 79% in just the last few weeks, and I’m still viewed favorably by a 12-point margin (45% to 33%), even after Abbott has spent millions attacking me.
Grassroots donations from this team made that possible. [**Will you make your first contribution so we can reach the voters who still don’t know me?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261021_2_leading.lmYmKi&refcode=em20261021-2497&t=3&akid=2497%2E299639%2Es-SQCD)
Together, we’ve turned this race from a long shot into a dead heat. A few months ago, people said we’d never get this close to taking Texas back. Now we’re on the edge of making history.
But Abbott knows it too. He’s raised more than $141 million in this campaign and already spent over $120 million of it trying to stop us. He still has $17 million left to spend on false attack ads right as voting begins. **The undecided voters who will decide this race are about to be buried in them, and we need to make sure they hear from us too.**
If you’ve been meaning to give, now is the time. [**Can you make your first gift so we can stay on the air in the final weeks?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261021_2_leading.lmYmKi&refcode=em20261021-2497&t=5&akid=2497%2E299639%2Es-SQCD)

Thank you,
Gina

I never thought I'd write this, but I agree with Marjorie Taylor Greene. I ran against her in 2024. We don't agree on much. But this week she said the quiet part out loud. **Republicans aren't saying a word about the war with Iran, the Epstein files, or tariffs driving up prices. Her explanation:****"They are silent on that because they don't want to get in trouble with the big guy."**

France's benchmark **[10-year bond yield briefly crossed 5%](https://substack.com/redirect/9ea9c1c9-d77a-42a7-a993-b45774c71781?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Wednesday, the highest level **[since 2002,](https://substack.com/redirect/6eb115e6-2e4e-4d9c-99be-32f051fab9b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as riots and a budget standoff intensified pressure on government finances.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/073982c4-cb50-459a-a328-c5e1522270c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Yield spike:** The 10-year OAT[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/5482afb9-6e70-47e1-a270-dc43736bd4b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[topped 5% before settling near 4.98%,](https://substack.com/redirect/5482afb9-6e70-47e1-a270-dc43736bd4b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** rising about 7 basis points on the day.
* **Unrest toll:** Weekend protests and looting caused damages estimated in the hundreds of millions of euros, with Carrefour citing "unprecedented" conditions.
* **Fiscal targets:** The government is seeking €54 billion in spending cuts; Finance Minister Lescure said cuts will proceed if parliament does not approve them.
* **Contagion watch:** The spread over German Bunds approached 160 basis points as investors weighed bank exposure and Moody's review.

* * *
# [Musk blindsides Ukraine by throttling Starlink that kills drones](https://substack.com/redirect/073982c4-cb50-459a-a328-c5e1522270c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Elon Musk **[ordered a slowdown of a military-grade Starlink](https://substack.com/redirect/51c02cc7-f876-490f-a932-3762da991762?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** version that Ukraine has used in its war with Russia, disrupting drone operations and catching Kyiv off guard, according to U.S. officials.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/073982c4-cb50-459a-a328-c5e1522270c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Speed cap:** The order capped speeds for fast-moving terminals, **[affecting Ukrainian air defense and drone systems.](https://substack.com/redirect/3b1eb8f0-fe0b-4639-a777-2b10eb474600?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **Timing:** The slowdown occurred around mid-October; Ukrainian officials were not given advance notice.
* **Trump denial:** President Trump denied ordering the move; Musk has discussed Ukraine with the White House.
* **Military reliance:** Ukraine has depended on the higher-speed service for battlefield communications and targeting.

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..rMFi5Z5NWLTKo4eAKIuz_dWgqnXKKrCvMWDDYNN_6W8?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=221499751)
* * *
# [First Russian diesel tanker sails for US under Trump deal](https://substack.com/redirect/073982c4-cb50-459a-a328-c5e1522270c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The **[first Russian tanker carrying 40,000 metric tons of diesel](https://substack.com/redirect/2856544e-48e2-471c-8fa9-2cc710832ca2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** is set to depart for the United States on Thursday under a fuel deal reached between the Trump administration and Moscow.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/073982c4-cb50-459a-a328-c5e1522270c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Volume ramp:** The deal calls for 300,000 tons right away, 500,000 tons in November, and 1 million tons thereafter.
* **Witkoff thanks:** **[Special envoy Steve Witkoff thanked Putin](https://substack.com/redirect/cc6a4062-f5b1-4caf-aee0-fa89d15a123b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in St. Petersburg for lifting export controls, saying the President is "deeply grateful."
* **Novak confirmation:** Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak said additional shipments will follow and Russia will meet U.S. needs.
* **Market reaction:** Global diesel prices fell 5-6% on the announcement as Brent held near $110.

* * *
# [UK inflation jumps to 3.5% as Jackdaw gas field gets green light](https://substack.com/redirect/073982c4-cb50-459a-a328-c5e1522270c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**[U.K. inflation rose to 3.5% in September from 3.1% in August,](https://substack.com/redirect/d80b4628-3b23-4f3d-aeed-9f0912bf1d1e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** driven by surging motor fuel prices, while the government approved the controversial Jackdaw North Sea gas field.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/073982c4-cb50-459a-a328-c5e1522270c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Fuel driver:** Motor fuel prices jumped 29.8% year-over-year, the highest rate since August 2022.
* **Rate path:** Markets price two Bank of England hikes by year-end, with a 98% chance of a 25-basis-point move next month.
* **Jackdaw green light:** The field **[is expected to boost U.K. gas output](https://substack.com/redirect/c205810a-f826-43dd-a72f-81302e3d0521?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** by about 6% at peak and operate for 11 years.
* **Budget pressure:** The print adds to challenges ahead of the Oct. 28 Budget as borrowing also exceeded forecasts.

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..rMFi5Z5NWLTKo4eAKIuz_dWgqnXKKrCvMWDDYNN_6W8?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=221499751)
* * *
# [FAA finally certifies Boeing 737 MAX 10 after years of delays](https://substack.com/redirect/073982c4-cb50-459a-a328-c5e1522270c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The Federal Aviation Administration **[certified the Boeing 737 MAX 10](https://substack.com/redirect/2eaadceb-1591-4e0d-957d-0787c61e507d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Tuesday, clearing the largest model in the family after years of delays **[tied to prior safety issues.](https://substack.com/redirect/8e6931d0-0014-4608-bff0-9bade5ebe1b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/073982c4-cb50-459a-a328-c5e1522270c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Order book:** The MAX 10 accounts for about 30% of Boeing's MAX backlog, with 1,555 orders from more than 30 customers.
* **Delay history:** Certification was pushed from a 2020 target due to post-crash scrutiny and engineering changes including an anti-icing system.
* **Duffy comment:** Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said the U.S. must certify aircraft more quickly to compete with Europe and China.
* **Production ramp:** The approval supports Boeing's effort to increase 737 output, with a fourth line opened in Everett in July.

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..rMFi5Z5NWLTKo4eAKIuz_dWgqnXKKrCvMWDDYNN_6W8?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=221499751)
* * *
# [RTX raises outlook again as missile demand fuels rearmament](https://substack.com/redirect/073982c4-cb50-459a-a328-c5e1522270c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
RTX lifted its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance for a third straight quarter after a strong third-quarter print **[driven by missile demand](https://substack.com/redirect/12e56a1d-f1a5-4d8f-9377-cff22e0cc7e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and commercial aftermarket strength.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/073982c4-cb50-459a-a328-c5e1522270c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Guidance lift:** Full-year adjusted EPS now seen at $7.65-$7.75, up from a prior ceiling of $7.25.
* **Quarterly beat:** Adjusted EPS of $2.26 topped the $1.78 FactSet consensus on $24.97 billion in revenue.
* **Backlog context:** Northrop Grumman separately reported a record $110 billion backlog amid broad defense demand.
* **Tariff recovery:** Results included recoveries related to IEEPA tariffs.

My opponent, Carmela Conroy, said this in a Seattle Times article: "I'm not even sure if we were in Seattle I would qualify as a Democrat."
What nonsense! She was chair of the Spokane County Democrats and as liberal as they come.
They've tried this trick before.
In our August primary, the far-left extremists feared a Democrat couldn't win in Eastern Washington, so they ran a socialist Democrat as an "independent." Nate Powell was a Bernie Sanders supporter backed by progressive groups and Washington, D.C. dark money, and the moment the primary ended, he endorsed Carmela Conroy.
Some “independent.” Now Conroy is trying the same trick.
Think about that. The candidate who chaired the local Democrat Party is suddenly not sure she's a Democrat at all.

Hi, it’s Jon Ossoff. I’m the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won. And this U.S. Senate race in Georgia will be one of the most competitive and most expensive in the nation. So if you’re upset by what’s being done to our country right now and you’re ready to fight back, please chip in what you can to support my campaign here in Georgia. **Here’s the link to donate:**[**https://act.electjon.com/go/donate**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-oct26.FRbHBd&refcode=em261021-4-f&utm_campaign=em261021-4-f&t=3&akid=3114%2E5691347%2EMegGdm) Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for the Senate — and why this moment is even more urgent. Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution. More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminded me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation. Trump’s rise wasn’t just a crisis. It was a warning. I ran for Senate because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency and I wanted to confront the corruption that made his rise possible. We defeated him, and I won. But now returned to power, this President is staging a power grab unprecedented in our history:
* He’s freed violent criminals who attacked the Capitol on his behalf.
* Stacked key agencies with loyalists — and called on them to investigate his political opponents.
* Threatened to take news broadcasters off the air unless they met his demands for more favorable news coverage.
* And even called for elected Democrats to be EXECUTED.

**This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream. As citizens, it is the test of our lifetimes.** In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn’t be done. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history — and _we won._ That victory won the Senate majority. Now we must win again. Derek, this is an email from the Democratic National Committee about our work to flip Congress in 13 days. If you need help checking your voter registration or making a plan to vote, please visit [iwillvote.com](https://ak.democrats.org/go/9784?t=2&akid=10001%2E22930333%2EXUaXuF). If you'd prefer to [receive fewer emails](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/receive-less-email/?t=3&akid=10001%2E22930333%2EXUaXuF) or [stop receiving our emails](https://ak.democrats.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=4&akid=10001%2E22930333%2EXUaXuF), you can click [here](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/receive-less-email/?t=5&akid=10001%2E22930333%2EXUaXuF). Derek, we are in the final stretch before Election Day. **FIRST** : Thanks to our nationwide network of grassroots supporters like you, we crushed our end-of-quarter September fundraising goal. Surpassing this target helps to ensure we have the essential resources to keep powering Democratic efforts to reclaim the House and Senate this fall. **THEN** : Fundraising slowed significantly at the start of this month, putting us on the brink of lowering our October target. To effectively counter Donald Trump and the GOP’s massive **$1 BILLION** war chest, we need an immediate surge in grassroots support. [](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-october-2026-gfr.AWsDfI&refcode=em_20261021_10001_fr&amount=7&t=6&akid=10001%2E22930333%2EXUaXuF) **NOW** : Thousands of donors have stepped up to help us hit our final deadline before Election Day. Every grassroots donor represents an American ready to stand up, fight back, and prevent another two years of unchecked White House policies. While yesterday’s projections showed us falling 36% short of our target, we have narrowed that gap to 17% as of this morning. We’re trying to reach every voter in Westminster, Cerritos, Fullerton and everywhere in between before they fill in that bubble, and for a lot of them that’s happening this week. I know how close this district can get. Two years ago, I waited 22 days after Election Day to find out we flipped the seat by 653 votes. I don’t want to leave anything to chance this time. clean_body: | | | PPeter, it’s Pete Buttigieg. Earlier this month, I had the privilege of joining Stefany Shaheen on the stump in New Hampshire. Looking out at a packed room of Granite Staters on a Friday night, you could feel something unmistakable – energy around a shared belief that a better politics is possible, and that delivering on that starts with electing someone like Stefany. Stefany has spent her career stepping up for the people. When faced with her daughter’s Type 1 Diabetes diagnosis, she became a relentless advocate for families touched by chronic illness – working to connect those families with the health services they need and fueling research to find cures. When she joined the Portsmouth City Council, she delivered on her promise of building a safer and better community by cleaning up cancerous forever chemicals and strengthening public safety. Stefany knows that real leadership is about the commitment to service and that politics should be about helping and listening to all the voices in the room, not just the ultra-rich or well-connected. When we send Stefany to Congress, she’ll carry with her the stories and lived experiences of the Granite State families she’s spent a lifetime fighting alongside – and on day one, she’ll be hard at work to deliver results for them. With just 14 days to go until Election Day, Stefany needs our help to ensure that voters across the district hear her story and vision for a better New Hampshire. = | | | | | = | | | = | | | = | | | = | | | | = | | Thank you, Pete | | | | | | = | | | | | | Paid for by Stefany Shaheen for Congress | | Stefany Shaheen for Congress PO Box 193 Manchester, NH 03105 United States | | | | = | | | = | | This message was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. | |

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | Friend, when the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade four years ago, millions of women lost access to healthcare overnight. Republican legislatures across the country worked quickly to roll back access to abortion, fertility treatments, contraception, and other reproductive health care. Virginia is the only state in the South that hasn’t further restricted reproductive rights since the Dobbs decision. But we aren’t stopping there. We have a Constitutional Amendment on the ballot this year to enshrine access to reproductive care. = = When I became Governor, I made a commitment to Virginians that I would do everything in my power to protect reproductive rights. But Governors change. Laws can change. Legislatures can change. Virginians deserve the certainty of knowing their rights are protected in the Virginia Constitution. = = Early voting has begun, and we are in the final stretch of the campaign. President Trump was angry about **weakness in the labor market** under his administration, previously saying without evidence that the data were “ _rigged_ ” and then firing the bipartisanly Senate-confirmed Department of Labor official responsible for putting out the report each month.

The president had fired the official after the bureau released monthly jobs data showing surprisingly weak hiring and large downward revisions to job growth in the previous two months. **The report was widely interpreted as evidence that Mr. Trump’s policies were taking a toll on the economy.**

The firing**could further erode trust in government statistics** and make it more difficult for policymakers, investors, and businesses to make critical economic decisions.

Hi there,

Throughout this campaign, I’ve had the chance to speak to countless
Michiganders, and everywhere I go, from Detroit to Marquette to Grand
Rapids, I hear the same question: “Why are you running for governor?”

In case I don’t have a chance to meet you on the road here in Michigan,
I’ll tell you my official pitch in a second — but first I need you to know
this: I’m in this race to cut costs, raise wages, and end the corruption
that got us here because I firmly believe everyone deserves a fair shot in
life. [ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/22718?t=1002&akid=2039%2E181023%2ETi4lrU ]If that’s the kind of leadership you want fighting for you, I
could really use your help in these final days of our campaign. A donation
of any amount — even just $5 — can make an impact in a race this
competitive.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/22717?t=1003&akid=2039%2E181023%2ETi4lrU ]Donate →

I’m running to be a governor who fights for you.

I’ll cut costs, raise wages, and end corruption. I will fight for the
veteran who deserves access to the healthcare benefits they’ve earned. For
the teachers who deserve better pay and more respect. For our kids whose
future depends on what we do today.

I know how important that is as a mom, as the wife of a combat veteran,
and as the daughter of special education teachers who taught me that the
power of the people must always be greater than the people in power.

My opponent is only in this for himself. In just four years in Congress,
he’s become a multi-millionaire trading stocks in the very companies he’s
supposed to be regulating. While raising our healthcare premiums,
supporting a reckless war in Iran that’s driven up gas prices, and backing
Trump’s tariffs that have raised costs for Michiganders more than any
other state.

He’s not serving the people of Michigan — he’s profiting off of you.

But I want you to know that I will always fight for you.

I’ve done that as Secretary of State, and I’m ready to do it as governor.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/22717?t=1004&akid=2039%2E181023%2ETi4lrU ]But first, I need your help. The last 13 days of this campaign are
going to be the most difficult of them all. We can expect MAGA mega-donors
to rush millions to save my opponent and distort my record, and we need to
have the resources to respond. So please, if you can: Will you
make your very first

keep Michigan blue?

body:

| | | | Peter, For decades, bison have legally grazed on federal grasslands in Montana. But this winter, the Bureau of Land Management **suddenly reversed course, tore up the permits, and issued a formal eviction notice to nearly 1,000 bison on the prairie.** The administration suddenly decided that bison no longer count as "livestock" under the Taylor Grazing Act because they aren't being raised for "production-oriented purposes." Because this specific herd is managed for conservation and ecosystem health rather than maximum commercial slaughter, the government declared them ineligible to eat the grass. They want the bison hauled off so 63,000 acres of your public land can be handed over exclusively to commercial cattle operations. Here is why this matters to every single person who cares about the outdoors:
* This is a calculated move to establish that public lands exist _solely_ for private profit and corporate extraction.
* If they can arbitrarily ban the American bison—the literal, snorting symbol of the American West—from the prairie using a bureaucratic loophole, they can eliminate anything that stands in the way of a commercial lease.
* This policy shift was spearheaded by political appointees who were granted special ethics waivers to shape federal policy that directly benefits their former cattle industry clients.

We are not going to let them turn our prairies into a privatized feedlot. [**We are building a rapid-response war chest to expose this blatant overreach, fight back against the permit cancellations, and hold the politicians who engineered this purge accountable. This policy shift was spearheaded by political appointees who were granted special ethics waivers to shape federal policy that directly benefits their former cattle industry clients. We are not going to let them turn our prairies into a privatized feedlot. ~~ ~~ They think they can quietly evict the bison to appease their donors. Let's make it the most expensive political mistake they've ever made. You take our land—we take your seat. **Patriot, it’s John James. **
We're less than 3 weeks away from Election Day. Before I say anything else—as someone who has logged 750 combat hours in Iraq—I know every second counts, and there’s not a moment in the day we should be wasting. _I promise I will not waste your time._
I just want to tell you a little about myself; it’s about time we got well-acquainted.
I was born and raised in Michigan, and throughout high school, I felt a deep-rooted call to service. I decided I wouldn’t just read about service in the magazines, _**I would live it.**_
[**Eventually, this led me to apply to West Point, and my decision to serve my country would make me the man I am today.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=ab25256935f64518919db648b9388a35&_e=eJ3GRKnrUNK3emGftRakftfCgi1mEeei-vSgFgzAy_bSmHUcMZ6aLX1gyGWh2hiBTB7z3xdB2vBy4r25Bu9bpqeAezkrSqw3mtCfQ2oH-ezwFQvf-qoYqFFDuJS0gQWWDWeXBZROz5bafUGzSiXl5ksNo8vDLRRbc9caUEMnvr2OY_ySe5JeI0dRYhdJ2Mz2gkLbJrQ0V5xPKKsqTUn400jVi5sx6imOrfbNYmfJpW5uNFwl_KY_OnBdR4IvxMXCe4QW0d9dnC5Y07Q4JROhdx28GwQ0uGykjhY5Abl28k7Dw871e7L3syTT0hBExryHsfA0XSVbCR-8d0aNbyLPw4RNp2_r6B_7qvuhD89WZ3ELejpjlHEUZ8r4EyuRrGVNrOyFyw0PhjrzRl8wn-Rc4Rg5wykB3_3PAb8P20IM1u6fM1oIIxxngJ4C8QaY_0_JbmLEwZLhzH4PgFlGlnX_yiF49Lq2YvpgaJSTo-cmUbUbD1dwX4jLjrg3M87xcH7Yqv8larby2s8AIKAjITO51OHM9xe-SBJGpHnAXkyvHViIPEmaGg2GAZKCExSGRqy63tVELnmYgh-QgP1KX34FD5K_okjID8T2UkTRZIxByHa9YxdDugMKeTX1_dbyf1HzO-AJZBo9ZYMS-yy8nMTxGUb5MZg6vIH6y1HU3R4ihI2PHHBSgY20iEkPufgsP3hA-xshZFS_a4xZHHDyKLRPGUHkkL_RERS2NGJwIVqiEy9S17xNCa9V2JtcjLxHkGwi)

Graduating from West Point was just the beginning of my eight years in the United States Army.
During Operation Iraqi Freedom, I led Apache Helicopter Platoons, and I feel like I spent more time in the air than I did on the ground. Some nights, I didn’t know if I’d make it through the next day, and every mission I flew, I went into the unknown. **Throughout my service, I had the honor of receiving a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. **
**I wouldn’t trade my time in the service for anything, but I’ll be honest, it was good coming home, and _I can rest easy knowing I did my country proud._**

After coming back stateside, I swapped my fatigues for a suit. I took over the family business, creating jobs here in Michigan and earning a master’s in supply chain management from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan. clean_body: Will you have my back on November 3rd?| | | | | Patriot, it’s John James. We're less than 3 weeks away from Election Day. Before I say anything else—as someone who has logged 750 combat hours in Iraq—I know every second counts, and there’s not a moment in the day we should be wasting. I promise I will not waste your time. I just want to tell you a little about myself; it’s about time we got well-acquainted. I was born and raised in Michigan, and throughout high school, I felt a deep-rooted call to service. I decided I wouldn’t just read about service in the magazines, I would live it. Graduating from West Point was just the beginning of my eight years in the United States Army. During Operation Iraqi Freedom, I led Apache Helicopter Platoons, and I feel like I spent more time in the air than I did on the ground. Some nights, I didn’t know if I’d make it through the next day, and every mission I flew, I went into the unknown. Throughout my service, I had the honor of receiving a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. I wouldn’t trade my time in the service for anything, but I’ll be honest, it was good coming home, and I can rest easy knowing I did my country proud. After coming back stateside, I swapped my fatigues for a suit. I took over the family business, creating jobs here in Michigan and earning a master’s in supply chain management from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan. I was never one to rest, and after making so many life-or-death decisions in Iraq, I knew every second mattered; I wanted to make the most of my time for my family and me. I never for a second considered running for office, and the last thing I’d consider myself is a politician... I saw the Democrats destroying our country, and I knew my service to this great nation wasn’t over yet. Everybody told me running for office isn’t easy, but my heart was telling me it was the right thing to do. I won my election, with the help of President Trump, and started delivering results for my new constituents. Then, in 2023, when the Establishment tried to move on from Trump and being MAGA was seen as risky or politically inconvenient, I was among the first in Michigan to endorse President Trump for 2024. Loyalty isn’t a talking point to me; it’s the only way I know how to operate. My dedication to this country, my loyalty towards my constituents, and my desire to see the greatest nation on earth excel are part of the reasons why I’m now emailing you, but they’re not my #1 reason why... These three kids are the reason why I’m sending this message to you, as a TRUMP-ENDORSED Republican and father running to be the next governor of Michigan Having my own family taught me more lessons than I could list, and it was the one thing being in the U.S. Army didn’t prepare me for. But it also awoke in me a desire to do EVERYTHING and ANYTHING I can to ensure my kids have bright futures. My family means everything to me, and Michigan is our home; that’s why I will fight like my life depends on it to save this state and win this November. - I’m under no illusions; I know this election will be one of the toughest challenges I’ve faced in my entire life, but after everything I’ve done in my service, it’s nothing I can’t handle. Unfortunately, the one thing I can’t directly control is spending, and the Democrats will do everything in their power to stop my campaign from making it to the ballot box this November. Nothing can stop us from saving this country if we stand together. Today, I’m asking you to make a small-dollar gift of $10, $25, $50 or ANYTHING you can spare to fuel my campaign’s fight as we approach our upcoming November 3rd election. Thank you for taking the time to read my message. I hope to hear from you in the days to come. name: Bethany Mann for Congress
subject: Congress has a responsibility. So do I.
body:
Before we send another American into war

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/15qTbdFq6fu?e=519ef02502&c2id=654d9c3339d5694b9267d382db7ced0e)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

Friend,**Today, I released a statement opposing unauthorized military action against Iran and calling on Congress to reclaim its constitutional authority over war.**
I want to share that statement with you, but I also want to explain why this issue matters so much to me, both personally and as someone asking to represent Missouri's 3rd Congressional District.
I'm the daughter of an Air Force veteran and the granddaughter of a World War II servicemember. I was raised with a deep respect for military service and an understanding that the decision to send Americans into harm's way carries an enormous responsibility.
That responsibility belongs to Congress, not to any one president, regardless of political party.
When our government considers military action, we owe our servicemembers, their families, and the American people a clear explanation of why it is necessary, what we intend to accomplish, and how we intend to bring our people home.
We also owe Americans an honest accounting of what these decisions cost.
Every day, I meet Missouri families who are struggling to afford groceries, healthcare, housing, and the basic necessities of life. I hear from communities that need better roads and bridges, schools that need resources, and working people who feel like their government has forgotten them.
Yet somehow, when the conversation turns to another military conflict overseas, billions of dollars can become available with remarkably little discussion about what we are sacrificing here at home.
I believe we should be investing those resources in the American people, not expanding military conflicts without congressional authorization or a clear path toward peace.
**That's why I would vote to end unauthorized hostilities against Iran, oppose funding for unauthorized offensive military operations, and demand that Congress fulfill its responsibility to the American people.** Our servicemembers must always have the resources and protections they need to return home safely, but supporting our troops does not mean writing a blank check for war.
**You can read my full statement here:**
[**[READ BETHANY'S STATEMENT]**](https://us.list-manage.com/EBk1gxEs13B?e=519ef02502&c2id=654d9c3339d5694b9267d382db7ced0e)
**This is also why I'm running for Congress.**
I believe the people of Missouri deserve a representative who understands that public service means making difficult decisions, asking uncomfortable questions, and standing up for the people whose lives are affected by those decisions.
We need representatives who are willing to challenge their own party when necessary, who understand the value of a taxpayer dollar, and who recognize that the lives of our servicemembers are far too important to be treated as political bargaining chips.
That kind of representation doesn't happen on its own. It takes people willing to organize, volunteer, talk to their neighbors, and invest in a different kind of leadership.With Election Day approaching, every conversation and every contribution helps us reach more voters who deserve to know that they have a choice.
**If you believe Congress should answer to the people it represents, I hope you'll help us build the kind of representation Missouri deserves.**
**⬇️HELP US GET TO CONGRESS⬇️**

Make voting by mail confusing, make people afraid of it, and then throw out the ballots of anyone who slips up.** Oregon has voted by mail for decades, and it works. That's exactly why it's a target. The same people pushing these rules are also spreading lies that mail voting isn't safe, hoping Oregonians will doubt the system or just stay home. And that’s why it matters so much to have Secretary’s of State who are willing to defend vote-by-mail. **[That is why I am using my campaign to counter disinformation and make sure voters get their ballots sent in, whether it is in Oregon or in other states. subject: An unshakeable belief
body:
[1]LeftNet

It’s
Governor Wes Moore.

I will work with anybody. But I will bow to nobody.

I didn’t come from money or prestige. As the son of an immigrant single
mother, I came from hard work, community, and an unshakeable belief that
we could do better.

[ https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20261020_partner_ms_wes_em_leftnet.XAweCK&refcode=em20261021-1723&amount=5&t=1001&akid=1723%2E2118727%2EUA6kbB ]If you share that belief, would you make a donation of
$5 to my re-election campaign today?

My
grandfather was run out of his home by the Klan. But he rebuilt anyway.

That history and resilience is why I believe every family deserves a fair
shot at work, wages, and wealth — not just survival.

That’s what we’re building together: Teacher vacancies cut in half.
Violent crime at historic lows. The first statewide Service Year Option in
the country for every high school graduate.

My MAGA Republican opponent Dan Cox would undo all of it. And I will not
bow to him, or anyone who wants to take Maryland backward.

---
A note from Senator Ashley Moody |
---
Peter,
I'm going to be honest with you, because I don't know any other way to say this.
My heart breaks for France right now. City halls burning to the ground. More than 600 police officers injured in a single day. Rioters tearing the French flag off the monument to their own Republic – and raising a Palestinian flag in its place, while others march under the hammer and sickle.
Communists and radical Islamists, side by side in the streets. **That 's not a coincidence. That's an alliance.** And it has eyes on more than Europe.
This radical movement is working to infiltrate our own country – and it's counting on patriots like you not realizing it until it's too late.
It is the honor of my life to serve as Florida's U.S. Senator. My state is full of people who already know how this story ends. Families who fled Castro with nothing but the clothes on their backs. Venezuelans who watched their country get looted by socialists in a single generation. Nicaraguans who escaped Ortega. They came here because America was the one place it couldn't happen.
Here, that movement has a fellow traveler on the ballot, and her name is **Angie Nixon.**
She runs a bookstore called "Cafe Resistance." On its wall hang portraits of convicted cop killers – including Assata Shakur, who murdered a New Jersey state trooper and fled to Castro's Cuba. When she was confronted about it, she said she stands by "everything in this bookstore."
She closes her speeches with a line from the Communist Manifesto – "We have nothing to lose but our chains" – and she took that chant to a CAIR gala. She was one of just 7 votes against teaching students the history of communism. She signed the pledge to abolish ICE. She voted against tougher penalties for people who assault police officers.

**I want to thank you.**
I mean it sincerely. If you told me just a few months ago that thousands of working-class people would step up and chip in what they could spare on a given day -- whether it's $1 or $100 -- I would've told you that you're nuts.
But that's what has happened on this campaign. We've built something truly special, and it's all thanks to you.
**[So if you're with me in this fight, there's never been a more important time to step up and get involved. We've got a $200,000 fundraising deadline to reach at midnight, and I'm counting on your support to reach it. Think you can spare a few bucks right now?](https://substack.com/redirect/7f8385c2-edbc-428a-91fe-9fc0b21ef4f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[SUPPORT OUR PEOPLE-POWERED CAMPAIGN ->](https://substack.com/redirect/7f8385c2-edbc-428a-91fe-9fc0b21ef4f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I grew up in a family that didn't have a lot of money to our name. I became a logger, just like my dad was -- and his dad before him. And the truth is, people like me, my family, and folks across my small town of Allagash, we don't have very many people in our government who will go to bat for us.
That's why I stepped up and got involved in public service, because every Mainer deserves a seat at the table no matter their postal code or background.
Just last week on the debate stage, I told Susan Collins the truth: **You can bet that I 'll represent Mainers in the Senate, because they're who have made me into the person I am today.**
On the other hand, she's shown us (for nearly 30 years now) that she couldn't disagree more. She's catered to the wealthy elite who have gotten rich off of the backs of the working class -- people like you and me.
And in vote after vote, she's given them tax breaks to stuff their pockets while families were forced to choose between putting groceries on their tables or the prescriptions they need to live.
It's just wrong, and it's not how our government should work.
So I'm fighting like hell to give us a government that we deserve. That's why I've always said our campaign isn't from the left or the right; we're from the bottom, and we're rising.
Poll after poll shows me tied with Susan Collins, and there are still 5% of Mainers undecided in this race. Time is running out for us to reach them, and we've been outspent by Susan Collins 2:1 on TV ads.
**[We've got 13 days left to make a difference in this race, and it's going to come down to the wire. Your support today could be the difference in one of the most expensive Senate races in the country. Will you chip in $10 (or more, if you can swing it) before our fundraising deadline at midnight?](https://substack.com/redirect/c385869a-40e4-4ce1-bb80-824d297c7cb6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[SUPPORT OUR PEOPLE-POWERED CAMPAIGN ->](https://substack.com/redirect/c385869a-40e4-4ce1-bb80-824d297c7cb6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Solidarity forever,
\- Troy

#
**Know Before You Vote: ** **Janoo Believes Economic Growth Should Not Be a Priority **
* * *
Amanda Janoo has spent years advocating for a _very_ different approach to economic growth – because she doesn’t believe economic growth should be a goal of the government. It’s part of a so-called “post-growth” philosophy. But what does “post-growth” actually mean?
_**WHAT IS ‘POST-GROWTH’ ECONOMICS? **_ In simple terms, “post-growth” theories reject the idea that increasing economic growth and prosperity is beneficial and that it should not be a measure of success. Instead, it prioritizes economic contraction and the sharing of fewer economic resources among more people to reduce environmental impacts and, allegedly, to “improve well-being.” Put more bluntly, Amands Janoo says a growing economy does not mean people are better off – and Vermont should not prioritize economic growth as a result. In her 2023 interview on the Wellbeing Economic Alliance, Janoo states “the degrowth perspective was quite clear...we need to stop growing, right? Like we actually need to decline in a lot of areas.” Finally, in one academic paper, Janoo wrote governments “should abandon the objective of GDP growth.” _**IMPORTANTLY ... HOW DO JANOO’S VIEWS COMPARE WITH OTHER DEMOCRATS?**_ There is a BIG difference between Janoo’s call to abandon economic growth as a goal of government, and the emphasis leading national Democrats have placed on economic growth and American prosperity. President Barack Obama repeatedly defended the importance of a growing economy, calling economic growth the “North Star.” “Our top priority as a nation, and my top priority as President, must be doing everything we can to reignite the engine of America’s growth: a rising, thriving middle class,” he said. “That’s our North Star. That must drive every decision we make.” At the Democratic National Convention in 2024, Vice President Kamala Harris emphasized that she would work to bring together workers, entrepreneurs, small businesses and American companies “to create jobs, to grow our economy, and to lower the cost of everyday needs.” We cannot find any evidence of any mainstream Democrat advocating for a “post-growth” economy. In fact, the National Democratic Party platform identifies economic growth as a top priority. _**WHAT WOULD THIS MEAN FOR VERMONT? **_ In a WCAX interview, Janoo was asked if she thought Vermonters were ready to elect someone focused on challenging economic growth as a goal. Janoo confirmed her intent, saying “we’ll find out.”
_**That’s something to know before you vote. **_
-Team Scott **###** Sources:
1\. Amanda Janoo — Seven Ideas for the G7, Wellbeing Economy Alliance, August 23, 2019.
2\. Amanda Janoo — Now Is the Time: 5 Principles for Rebuilding a US Wellbeing Economy, November 2, 2020.
3\. Amanda Janoo — A Wellbeing Revolution, Greenpeace International interview. Discussion of post-growth and degrowth concepts.
4\. Amanda Janoo — Population Balance: The Wellbeing Economic Alliance. Podcast interview, June 22, 2023
5\. President Barack Obama — Ensuring Our Free Market Works for Everyone, White House Weekly Address, April 16, 2016.
6\. Vice President Kamala Harris — Democratic National Convention remarks, August 22, 2024.
