Analysts say that Trump is continuing to pursue an elusive clean victory narrative, while Netanyahu understands this may be his last chance at continuing the war he has agitated for his entire political career. "This is Netanyahu's last chance to do so. And he's not going to leave until he turns every stone to be able to achieve it. Particularly knowing that either his career is going to end or the United States is going to go in a direction in which this no longer will be an option," said Trita Parsi, a leading Iran expert and the executive Vice President of the Quincy Institute. "Trump, I suspect, has already made a decision that he's going to go to war," he added. "The Israelis have been very successful playing to his psychology, which is that he's willing to take massive risks as long as he has the belief that it can get him a victory so that he avoids accepting defeat, which is so crucial for him. But it is a massive miscalculation that will make the situation 100 times worse." The intersection of Trump's and Netanyahu's political interests increases the chances that the war will resume, argues former senior U.S. Iran negotiator Robert Malley. "Netanyahu may want a longer campaign with broader objectives. Trump may want something shorter that he could quickly get out of. The overlap between the two might well be an intensive campaign that doesn't last too long," said Malley, a key figure in brokering the 2015 Iran nuclear deal. "President Trump may want a victory lap and an exit ramp. But as has been proven time and time again, the exit is not decided by him alone," said Malley, who currently directs the Middle East Program at the International Crisis Group. "There is every reason to believe the Iranians are preparing all kinds of steps, whether by them or by their regional partners, whether in or out of theater, to ensure that however much he wants a victory lap and an exit ramp, he is deprived of both." " We Are Prepared for the Next Stage" Gen. Rezaei is one of the most prominent military figures in modern Iranian history. A former commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, he was tapped to serve as the top military advisor to Khamenei in August. His comments are often viewed as reflecting the consensus at the top of Iran's power structure. He told Drop Site that despite U.S. claims to have "obliterated" or "decimated" Iran's military infrastructure, Iran spent decades preparing for a broader war waged by the U.S. | | ---|---|--- Gen. Mohsen Rezaei attends a ceremony at Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini's shrine in southern Tehran, Iran, on June 4, 2026. Photo by Morteza Nikoubazl/NurPhoto via Getty Images. "Iran has invested for years in building redundancy into these capabilities: dispersed production, underground facilities, different launch systems and the ability to repair damage and replace losses," Rezaei told Drop Site. "More importantly, you should not assess our capacity solely by asking how many missiles remain in storage. In a prolonged war, the central question is whether a country can sustain a continuous cycle of production, deployment and response. We have shown that, even months after the war began, we can still impose costs on the other side." Rezaei also indicated that Tehran would deploy new capabilities in its retaliatory response. "We did not deploy all our capabilities in the previous stages. We brought more capabilities into operation in proportion to the intensity of the war, and we are also prepared for the next stage," Rezaei said. During the war, Iran carried out at least 135 drone and missile strikes on 84 critical infrastructure sites across seven countries--Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Iraq, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, and Bahrain, according to a . While Gulf governments repeatedly attributed the damage to falling debris from intercepted Iranian missiles and drones, the investigation found evidence of deliberate, precision strikes targeting critical equipment. The attacks demonstrated "precision, targeting expertise, and patience," Ryan Stevens, a former U.S. Marine Corps special operations airstrike coordinator, told Reuters. Echoing Rezaei's warning about communications infrastructure, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps spokesperson, Hossein Mohebi, also threatened to target internet cables passing through the Strait of Hormuz if the U.S. launched renewed attacks. Mohebi further Monday that another U.S. military operation would trigger a global energy crisis. "If America takes a new action--even a limited one--the world will face a serious energy crisis," he told the Tehran Times. Rezaei did not rule out targeting energy infrastructure in Gulf states as a retaliatory measure. "If the U.S. strategy is to prolong the war while using neighboring countries' energy infrastructure to offset the pressure arising from Hormuz and maintain the blockade of Iran, those governments should not assume they can participate in economic warfare against Iran without putting themselves at risk," he said. "The message is not that Iran wants to destroy the Persian Gulf's energy system. The message is that there can be no arrangement in which Iran's economic lifelines come under attack while the economic architecture enabling those attacks is considered untouched and immune." The senior Iranian official said Trump's approach to Iran has been focused on short-term objectives that are often disconnected from geopolitical realities or core U.S. interests, likening him to a day trader. "The wartime secrecy surrounding military operations has given him and his family exclusive and extraordinary access to information regarding forthcoming actions and the state of the markets--access that benefits only those closest to him," he said. "Perpetuating the current situation will carry strategic consequences, not least that the energy markets will not find calm for the next three years. The continuation of this war has shifted the dynamics of relations in Iran's favor, as the littoral states of the Persian Gulf are rapidly redefining their relationship with Iran, having become convinced that the U.S. military is incapable of defending its own bases, this at a time when those same states had expected America to defend their countries." Iranian officials have said repeatedly that Iran will not back away from its red lines in any negotiations, consistently pointing to Tehran's acceptance of the June 17 Memorandum of Understanding, which was swiftly violated by the U.S., leading to a breakdown in the diplomatic process in early July. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said he presented a "Seven-Day Plan" to the U.S. through mediators at last month's UN General Assembly, outlining steps for an end to the war and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. "Under this proposal, the U.S. would not be expected to do anything that it has not already agreed to," Araghchi in an op-ed for the Financial Times on Wednesday. He said the framework's steps and outcome were clear: "The Strait would reopen on Day 6, with the resumption of talks for a final deal commencing on Day 7." Araghchi in an interview with Iraqi television that the U.S. had accepted the seven-day proposal but requested the addition of a "few more clauses," adding that diplomatic contacts through mediators remain ongoing. "As President Trump stated, Iran is in very bad condition, both economically and militarily, and the blockade will remain in full force and effect, with oil flowing in record numbers of barrels through the Hormuz Strait," Kelly told Drop Site in a statement. Rezaei told Drop Site that Iran's negotiating strategy has evolved as a result of Trump's unreliability. "We will not return to our previous approach to diplomacy, but we will not abandon diplomacy either. We have presented seven new conditions through intermediaries. Until those conditions are fulfilled, Iran will neither reopen the strait nor return to negotiations," Rezaei said. "The first memorandum failed because the commitments were implemented in the wrong order. We opened the strait and maritime traffic resumed, but the other side's political and economic commitments were not implemented in a way that could sustain the agreement. Once the United States obtained what it immediately needed, the balance of leverage shifted. That experience matters to us." "If Washington honors its commitments, there is a path to reopening the Strait of Hormuz and continuing diplomacy," he continued. "But Iran will not first give up the leverage that brought the other side to the negotiating table and then wait to see whether its promises are fulfilled." Parsi said that Iran is not eager to resume the war, but has recognized that the diplomatic track has been treated by the U.S. as an ultimatum operation masquerading as negotiations. "Their conclusion--based on extensive experience with Trump now--is that he simply won't back off unless his policy is reaching a cost to him that is intolerable. And that it's not concessions or face saving exits that will get Trump to back off, but simply that the policy becomes too costly." Attacks on ships in and around the Strait of Hormuz have surged to a record high in recent weeks, with more than two dozen vessels reporting attacks so far in October, according to data released Friday by the UK Maritime Trade Operations agency. The agency said the actual number was likely far higher, as the "majority of vessels attacked" were refusing to report incidents. The IRGC reported further attacks over the weekend and into Tuesday, including a supertanker carrying two million barrels of oil struck Saturday, another tanker hit Sunday, and two tankers that it said caught fire Tuesday after striking naval mines south of the Strait. Iran says it is targeting vessels violating its maritime restrictions or using unauthorized shipping routes. "Over the past two or three months, we have struck an average of five vessels belonging to these smugglers every night," Rezaei said. "Smuggling is taking place along the southern edge of the strait at enormous cost and with considerable risk. Trump then says the Strait of Hormuz is open." Despite the escalating attacks, oil exports from the Middle East appear to have rebounded past prewar levels, primarily through tanker-to-tanker transfers in the Gulf of Oman, and expanded use of Saudi and Emirati pipelines bypassing the Strait of Hormuz. However, oil prices remain high, hovering well above $100 per barrel of Brent crude amid fears of the ongoing attacks and diminishing U.S. fuel stockpiles. "The current price of oil reflects the reality," Rezaei said. "The management of Hormuz is a national asset for us, and this is not simply about collecting tolls. The main issue is security," he continued. "Charges can also be collected for security, insurance and environmental costs, but the importance of managing the strait goes far beyond the revenue it generates," he said. "We will continue managing it to maintain peace and security in the region, and we will not back down from this position." The senior Iranian official said that the standoff over the Strait of Hormuz "has become the new pretext--the nuclear issue, previously, was a lie upon which the war was launched--for the United States to prolong the war." Trump, he charged, "has fallen into the trap of prolonging what was advertised as the shortest of wars." A "war of attrition," he said, "will work to Iran's advantage and to America's detriment." The war has had a devastating impact on Iran's economy. As part of its escalation over the summer, the U.S. reimposed a blockade on Iran's southern ports and launched a new campaign of sanctions dubbed Operation Economic Outcast. The Iranian rial subsequently collapsed, falling to record lows, making imports dramatically more expensive and imposing even more scarcity on people in Iran. "Iran will suffer from a prolonged blockade; anyone who says otherwise is not being realistic. Families will bear the costs, investment will suffer, and sustaining some sectors of the economy will become more difficult. But economic pain and strategic collapse are not the same thing," Rezaei said. "Washington has repeatedly made the mistake of assuming that, if it can make life inside Iran difficult enough, Iran's political system will consequently accept America's strategic demands. These are two different calculations." "Our goal is not to make it to 2029. Our goal is to end the war on terms that reduce the likelihood of another war." clean_body: Help us send someone different to Washington. | | | = | | = | | | Hi friend, I've been an ironworker for nearly twenty years. In that time, I've worked alongside people from every corner of the political spectrum — Republicans, Democrats, independents. None of that mattered on the jobsite. What mattered was showing up, doing the work, and looking out for the person next to you. That's how I'm going to approach Congress. = | | = | | | Max Miller has never worked a day like that in his life. He got his seat handed to him, spent his time in Washington taking care of billionaires and donors, and is now spending everything he has to hold onto power he's never deserved. His own family has turned on him. Both Ohio Republican senators called on him to step aside. And he's still here. I don't care what party you belong to. If you're going to fight for working families, I'm with you. And if you're going to stand in the way of working people getting a fair deal, I'll stand up to you — even if that means standing up to my own party. That's not a line I'm using for this campaign. **The climb (2017 -2024)**
Jason McGowan and Sawyer Hemsley founded Crumbl in Logan, Utah in 2017 with one chocolate chip recipe and a franchise model they used to avoid owning stores themselves. The pink box and rotating weekly menu were engineered for TikTok -- and TikTok obliged. By early 2026, case studies counted roughly $1.2 billion in system-wide sales, 1,059 locations in all 50 states, and the #6 most-downloaded food app in America. Fortune was still calling it a "$1 billion-a-year cookie empire" in August.
**The fall (2025 -2026)**
Sales and traffic have now declined significantly for two straight years. A fan-run tracker, Crumbl Cookie Flavors, counted at least 60 permanent closures in 2026 by October 14 (other reports say 57+), with HQ layoffs reported alongside. A widely circulated internal document reportedly showed sales down about 70% from two years earlier; viral posts claim traffic fell 32% year-over-year -- treat both as reported, not audited. Average annual store sales have fallen. In May 2026, the founders announced they'd step away from day-to-day operations to make room for outside leadership. McGowan's own words to franchisees: "It's my fault."
**The self-inflicted wounds**
In 2025 McGowan pitched franchisees on "dirty sodas," predicting a 20% sales bump -- instead the 32-ounce version packed 186 grams of sugar, the internet did the math, and McGowan says Soda Week became the worst week in company history. Then the ingredient lists quietly vanished from the official app and website, converting criticism into suspicion. Food Babe-style audits had long flagged what the pink sugar cookie actually contained: FD&C Red 40, Red 3, Yellow 5, titanium dioxide, propylene glycol, seed oils, bleached flour, high-fructose corn syrup. Add a reported $18.50 four-pack price, and the unit economics started reading like the ingredient list.
**The MAHA Era question**
In the MAHA era, synthetic dyes stopped being invisible: the FDA banned Red 3 in food (compliance deadline January 2027), HHS leaned on brands to drop artificial colorings, and "seed oils" became a political noun. A cookie whose signature pink comes from Red 40 reads differently in that environment, and TikTok -- the same channel that built Crumbl -- now monetizes tearing it down. The ingredient-label removal made it look like confirmation.
Full-size Crumbl cookies contain 550 to 1,240 calories each, depending on the flavor and toppings.
But attribution is not established. Leadership blames strategy and saturation: too many stores chasing a viral fad that normalized down, prices up, a misjudged soda pivot. The honest verdict: MAHA-era health scrutiny was an accelerant that turned a franchise-math problem into a cultural one -- a brand that ran on appetite was caught on camera with its ingredients.
The symmetry is the story: Crumbl was made by a phone camera and unmade by one.

The Rise and Fall of Crumbl | | | Oct 21 | | | | | | | | | | | | The climb (2017 -2024) Jason McGowan and Sawyer Hemsley founded Crumbl in Logan, Utah in 2017 with one chocolate chip recipe and a franchise model they used to avoid owning stores themselves. The pink box and rotating weekly menu were engineered for TikTok -- and TikTok obliged. By early 2026, case studies counted roughly $1.2 billion in system-wide sales, 1,059 locations in all 50 states, and the #6 most-downloaded food app in America. Fortune was still calling it a "$1 billion-a-year cookie empire" in August. The fall (2025 -2026) Sales and traffic have now declined significantly for two straight years. A fan-run tracker, Crumbl Cookie Flavors, counted at least 60 permanent closures in 2026 by October 14 (other reports say 57+), with HQ layoffs reported alongside. A widely circulated internal document reportedly showed sales down about 70% from two years earlier; viral posts claim traffic fell 32% year-over-year -- treat both as reported, not audited. Average annual store sales have fallen. In May 2026, the founders announced they'd step away from day-to-day operations to make room for outside leadership. McGowan's own words to franchisees: "It's my fault." The self-inflicted wounds In 2025 McGowan pitched franchisees on "dirty sodas," predicting a 20% sales bump -- instead the 32-ounce version packed 186 grams of sugar, the internet did the math, and McGowan says Soda Week became the worst week in company history. Then the ingredient lists quietly vanished from the official app and website, converting criticism into suspicion. Food Babe-style audits had long flagged what the pink sugar cookie actually contained: FD&C Red 40, Red 3, Yellow 5, titanium dioxide, propylene glycol, seed oils, bleached flour, high-fructose corn syrup. Add a reported $18.50 four-pack price, and the unit economics started reading like the ingredient list. The MAHA Era question In the MAHA era, synthetic dyes stopped being invisible: the FDA banned Red 3 in food (compliance deadline January 2027), HHS leaned on brands to drop artificial colorings, and "seed oils" became a political noun. A cookie whose signature pink comes from Red 40 reads differently in that environment, and TikTok -- the same channel that built Crumbl -- now monetizes tearing it down. The ingredient-label removal made it look like confirmation. Full-size Crumbl cookies contain 550 to 1,240 calories each, depending on the flavor and toppings. But attribution is not established. Leadership blames strategy and saturation: too many stores chasing a viral fad that normalized down, prices up, a misjudged soda pivot. The honest verdict: MAHA-era health scrutiny was an accelerant that turned a franchise-math problem into a cultural one -- a brand that ran on appetite was caught on camera with its ingredients. The symmetry is the story: Crumbl was made by a phone camera and unmade by one. | | ---|---|--- Thanks for reading! This post is public so feel free to share it. My team and I are working across the Commonwealth to put clear registration information in front of Virginians and help more people make a plan to vote. = = Registration is more than paperwork. It is how a neighbor claims a voice in decisions about schools, health care, costs, rights, and the future of our communities. After October 23, eligible Virginians can still register in person and cast a provisional ballot. But the regular deadline is the clearest and simplest moment to act, and no one should miss it because they never saw the date. That is why this outreach matters now. We need to repeat the deadline, encourage people to check their status, and make sure Virginians know where to find official registration information before time runs out. body:
Do you remember me sending you this?

Dear Peter,

It's been a whole year since I sent you the message below.

Since that time, we've made some amazing accomplishments. You helped
me expose Josh Kaul's failing record on crime labs. We received
endorsements from over 80% of Wisconsin sheriffs, another huge
accomplishment. We even had the best initial fundraising quarter for
an attorney general race in Wisconsin history...

And I had a birthday. 😅

But now we're just weeks away from the election, and things are
getting tight. If you're able, please CONSIDER MAKING A CONTRIBUTION
OF $25, $50, OR WHATEVER YOU CAN TO HELP POWER US TO NOVEMBER 3RD.
[https://link.action.erictoney.

Thank you for standing with me this past year. I hope I can count on
you to stay by my side until Election Day.

Eric

_ONE YEAR AGO..._

[https://link.action.erictoney.

Dear friend,

Everything was put into perspective for me two years ago.

I was 39 and had just been told I needed open-heart surgery. Mind you,
I run marathons, so this was never a position I imagined myself being
in.

I promised myself that if I survived that operating table I would do
something with my life to make a difference for Wisconsin, WHICH IS
WHY I AM PROUD TO TELL YOU FIRST THAT I HAVE ENTERED THE RACE TO BE
YOUR NEXT ATTORNEY GENERAL.

You and your families deserve SAFE communities, victims DESERVE
JUSTICE, and criminals deserve to face the REPERCUSSIONS of their
actions. _But under the current AG, Josh Kaul, we aren’t seeing
justice. _

A border that has been too open for too long has allowed our
communities to be flooded with meth and fentanyl, overwhelming our
local resources and resulting in the needless deaths of Wisconsinites.
A_pparently, to Josh Kaul, this is just the new normal..._

IT'S TIME FOR A CHANGE. AND I'M READY TO BRING THAT CHANGE.

Please consider helping me in these critical early weeks by
contributing $1,000, or any generous amount up to $20,000 per person.
[https://link.action.erictoney.

This isn’t a vanity campaign; I have the tried-and-true credentials
it takes to be successful. As a District Attorney and having been
President of the Wisconsin District Attorneys Association, I always
put public safety over politics.

I’m proud to have worked across party lines with a Democrat Governor
and a Republican Legislature to deliver pay raises for our prosecutors
and public defenders, as well as create over 50 new prosecutor
positions where they were needed the most.

_With your support, we can turn our state around, starting on Day One,
to make our communities safer, restore competence to the crime labs,
confront the drug crisis with the urgency it demands, and protect
Wisconsin._

Are you with me?

[https://link.action.erictoney.

ERIC TONEY
_Republican Candidate for Wisconsin Attorney General _

[https://link.action.erictoney.

<< CONTRIBUTE NOW >>
[https://link.action.erictoney.

EricToney.com
[https://link.action.erictoney.

Paid for by Toney for Attorney General
[https://link.action.erictoney.

name: America Fitzpatrick, LCV
subject: TAKE ACTION: Hands Off Alaska’s Wilderness!
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTQwNDA4MjgS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjU2MDExMTMwMwS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Reject Ambler Road, Protect Alaska’s Wilderness!

The Trump administration is advancing a proposal to open one of the largest remaining roadless wildlands on Earth to destructive
open-pit copper, zinc, and lead mining.

The Ambler Road Project proposes a 200-mile road through Alaska’s wilderness. If
this project becomes reality, it would devastate Alaska Native communities, as
well as Alaska’s ecosystems and wildlife — all to benefit Trump’s corporate
cronies and foreign mining interests.

We have until November 2 to voice opposition to this destructive proposal. Stand with Alaska Native communities and add your voice today!

Act Now: https://links.messages.lcv.
Reject Ambler Road, Protect Alaska’s Wilderness! https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/bxyvTV~Ex8F- ADD YOUR NAME https://links.messages.lcv. Peter, The Trump administration is, once again, advancing a toxic open-pit copper,
zinc, and lead mine in northwestern Alaska: the Ambler Road Project. This project proposes a 200-mile road through one of the largest remaining
roadless wildlands on Earth.If it becomes reality, it would devastate Alaska Native communities, as well as
Alaska’s ecosystems and wildlife — all to benefit Trump’s corporate cronies and
foreign mining interests. Reject Ambler Road, protect Alaska’s wilderness >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/4L4XBd~ TAKE ACTION NOW https://links.messages.lcv. Alaska Native communities have been leading the opposition to Ambler Road. The
project would greenlight the destruction of hundreds of miles of wilderness and
more than 3,000 streams and rivers that are important for subsistence and
wildlife, and threaten water sources and fisheries with toxic contamination. Beyond cutting through swaths of pristine wilderness to build the road, this
project would have far-reaching environmental impacts across 200,000 acres of public lands, which
would be devastating for this region. This is just one more example of Trump handing over even more of our public
lands to corporations to serve the interests of his billionaire buddies in the
fossil fuel, logging, and mining industries. Big Oil billionaires should never come before the public good. These decisions
are reckless and will hurt Alaska Native communities and Alaska’s wildlife. Take
a stand and voice your opposition to this dangerous project today! Add your name today: NO Ambler Road! https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/X6bzs~ Thank you for standing up for Alaska’s wilderness, and for the health and safety
of people and the planet. America Fitzpatrick

clean_body: Our Congress is on the hook for this | | | | = Hey Peter, Representatives like Brad Knott keep siding with his party and following the president's wishes, regardless of how it affects folks back home. His voting record shows he's sided with the president (Yep, I know, I’m sure some of you thought it would be higher...). We’re paying more at the pump and at the grocery store because Congress has refused to do its job and stand up to the president on issues like the Iran war and tariffs. Today, more than ever, we need members of Congress willing to be independent, stand up to the corruption taking over Washington, and work across party lines to get things done. Our voices deserve to be heard. We need leaders who solve problems with people-based solutions, like lowering the cost of living, expanding access to healthcare, and ensuring our rural communities aren't left behind. With voting still underway, I could use your help amplifying our message to voters across the district. = = Talk more soon, Paul Barringer Candidate for US Congress | | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | | | | Paid for by Paul Barringer for Congress | | | | Paul Barringer for Congress PO Box 114 Sanford, NC 27331 United States

I have been a first-hand witness to three disruptive moments in American politics. What I am watching build right now may be the fourth — and unlike the others, this one could go either way. | Peter,

I have been involved in three really disruptive moments in American politics.

The first was Ronald Reagan in the late seventies and early eighties. People thought he was a cowboy who did not know what he was doing. Nine years later, the Soviet Union disappeared. That was a disruption.

The second was 1994, when I helped lead Republicans to the first House majority in forty years. We had a Contract with America. We had candidates who signed it. We had a grassroots base that understood exactly what was at stake. And we won because we did the organizing work before the election, not after it.

The third is Donald Trump, a disruptor whose legacy, I have said publicly, may rival the most consequential presidents in American history if the 2026 midterms go well for Republicans.

**_[Peter, that last part is the one I need to talk to you about.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=d09797a35f3c489bbf1eace9b5d67ff6&_e=d4nXF99sH8sWRS-1JcV5IqffqXLqj-k1jSs07-R5V4xXe1px2suuimCe4OdgH19immYEGNV-tudiQVtXe5gXc10QW_YJrldkJekDmHcIxRPjxmFFhAzxrNAv2pvKFcnjAa_phOfaR9iS_LrGCp9Qlx-aVFJls6QVAALeYvwktW-x3_bxVleyjTmTaer_z-Zop_iAHoWqnGrmn0jKOa0lG8ROghR-ctzcIbgOFt0aenpzJm2HgYtGGZE7qY2YgrplT8MpSDhUNbmwOBogSFLqdo2OCW8LVPMHw5n_Pqrr6xq87tUNAfW_IgYup4MtEo2Z9I2H8ZbqzDwKvZbggS33JToqCRTsuqB0f6L36_5bal4z5pvEmY68WtPkuxMQHmrzixPx2NyUdwJY_5vAUEhtgrdZWA0j-5LgzGoELbMJaLyPMQMCjP8DRPEY3MO5cRedBVgovdkp_Q7j18ADMsmJN74O-Sxlfb1i1O5wHm_VOjSv_hFojymo0EXaCjMKzwXPIiXqbD9dGZZBtDJtIgdpG0vBwUVKj9ajQpzWLz716bulC0eBYIZU68xi4rzWRGupiMPTMjOg-qlhx7dGI1-4HBJxh5RFS0BbDIkfB0VBQ3EKjGCwYiik64yp9WNHw8TQf88exxJtD_X6k4401rrVPj3VJ91WelpJuSL-k9OvIToqIOre0t9QKv7u-O5M64rhm04UE_9BTMMc98DsW-vfmB1HsrM9isgkT1cfzL_4tHsudlywJK2FNLJpnVzMT6d-T0_5_SHj7G1zFo35iBe2kp9PvxiunG_kLTHZ15KTixvhik-3FBbWCTMZac0KcdK8mgO8nNiwIC1SJJpescWPUK9S0TKyBHEwT62NCZm6eY18SRzRB6rtYCvSm6gR_WKyXmGmiv3b2_liT-p0uHRn25mQP9cVeSlhPM7oo2A9ViiAPYzzeS3XzeHMAnRYyEinhyxdCgrSChkpMANMzmvOTtoq39nl2ea74eAIl1qCZ5nUrFi6GhW82Pfy__YElAYtGKidJWDFpu-ZUF5GiuMSeMAwe9TEFIHLuznTxGmEfsPmqI5GUU4MnFrpC509PseJUR4P6_mIQY_QM4GwcbUOw4HjaJz9S3CPKUi8pWYDpbg%3D)_ **

clean_body: I have been a first-hand witness to three disruptive moments in American politics. What I am watching build right now may be the fourth — and unlike the others, this one could go either way. | Peter, I have been involved in three really disruptive moments in American politics. The first was Ronald Reagan in the late seventies and early eighties. People thought he was a cowboy who did not know what he was doing. Nine years later, the Soviet Union disappeared. That was a disruption. The second was 1994, when I helped lead Republicans to the first House majority in forty years. We had a Contract with America. We had candidates who signed it. We had a grassroots base that understood exactly what was at stake. And we won because we did the organizing work before the election, not after it. The third is Donald Trump, a disruptor whose legacy, I have said publicly, may rival the most consequential presidents in American history if the 2026 midterms go well for Republicans. I have watched majorities built and I have watched them collapse. I know what the organization looks like when it succeeds and I know what it looks like when it quietly falls apart. And right now, in the Senate races that will determine whether President Trump has a working legislative majority for the next two years, I am seeing something that concerns me. They are winning primaries in Michigan. They are running in states we have not had to defend in a generation. Their candidates are going into November better funded than ours in Texas, Iowa, North Carolina, and Georgia. History teaches us that those who refuse to learn from its lessons are doomed to repeat them. I have spent sixty years learning these lessons. The lesson right now is that organized, funded conservatives win Senate majorities. Complacent ones hand them to Chuck Schumer. If I were a Democrat right now, I would feel very confident heading into November. I am not going to let that confidence be justified. In the fight, Newt Gingrich Former Speaker of the House | | Paid for by the NRSC. Not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. subject: I wish I were kidding.
body:
|

Friend, I don’t usually do this, but I need to set the record straight. My MAGA, J6-attending opponent, Tom Smith, is getting desperate. In just the past few weeks, he’s called me a **communist** and said I’m **anti-military.** I wish I were kidding. Instead of his lies, let me tell you the truth... Earlier this month, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce gave me its Advocate for American Business Award. That’s not exactly an honor they hand out to communists. Growing our economy and creating opportunities for mid-Michigan families have always been at the heart of my work. And a few days later, the Michigan Fraternal Order of Police endorsed my re-election campaign. Making sure mid-Michigan is safe has always been one of my top priorities – and that’s why I’m committed to ensuring law enforcement has the resources they need to protect our communities. **Funny how the guy who was at the Capitol on January 6th wants to lecture me about what’s extreme.** [**With 13 days left to go until Election Day, we can’t afford to have our message drowned out by baseless attacks. The Trump administration is trying to wreck the Census. Here’s why that matters >> | |
---
Peter, The Census matters more than you think. It’s more than a count of how many people live in America’s towns, counties, and states. It defines how political representation is set up. It determines which communities receive which resources—including healthcare resources and hospital funding. **That’s exactly why the wannabe dictator in the White House is meddling with it. He, his allies on the captured Supreme Court, and the wealthy extremists in the shadows are on a mission to steal resources from everyday people and hand them straight to the elites.** No one knows better about our rights being stolen and our healthcare resources drained than Planned Parenthood. That’s why they’re driving a public comment period defending a fair and accurate Census. [**We’re proud to stand with Planned Parenthood. A democracy means the system works for EVERYONE, and that requires a Census that takes ALL of us into account. Submit your comment to the Census Bureau now!**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMde6E5U0L3Jog5zF97H78Eohs3suca2qXQIOWnPdxwvZKSFTp5p4zujEhrA8L0brOrZWWqqPGzTlfKEIDE9kBBLbduX98E_vGV-VOpsg_Vj6HMKm76_wtGuHSgtO2dld2VzZyZSj-SQFvM_pIsN9swJOaD49KfLxIpETU_QZX-51aQX-K4mM-W3fthT0aKsNMsGRU6NKY-6866U6FSOmg7kMhJA2TaBvrz9YrjYBJruurvbCa1OpU-DHJN9eRhPsfUP-hNz84e6afXFnQ6yzzUxGUNN7tdePcN8v2wk8Q_w8Q5FRQawQ4k1XftZgc20thx9syGMsGmD1pl3e-750a34H7vNTg7Si2IPzL3nJEfYT/4v2/RfnoNdX0QhySzUQ17ljI9Q/h0/h001.PyNQESYI8rHHwu2YujJh5CT-mhIk0AXMUP-4qnEtuMw) [**ADD A COMMENT**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMde6E5U0L3Jog5zF97H78Eohs3suca2qXQIOWnPdxwvZKSFTp5p4zujEhrA8L0brOrZWWqqPGzTlfKEIDE9kBBLbduX98E_vGV-VOpsg_Vj6HMKm76_wtGuHSgtO2dld2ZJuyXUIcUFjNjE1XqmIfVx6k_mzGL-dV-MxpG-GFo9WhHoz4P-UrGXr8asVloyaehjxudyo_aThhIpKp0CwchTcUkjog3pTo5bBNhoUTbSZ5Q6_LeUO8aFBr2h82xQzdvwo4weBrpwAIZwCafEj3Nr8NZADthtL1EORE-ea2NZOWYwvXvLktnYEKHDJ6r1ZJ8Q9t7QZTGzDSGbiuewswEp8XWiGny-Nwa_sw5V1ashO/4v2/RfnoNdX0QhySzUQ17ljI9Q/h1/h001._-jG0srDWVDu0aBiXmLzS-1YL3V4NO61ES2aQ6Ev940) The new changes proposed to the Census would exclude most noncitizens from the count. They also BAN questions on race, ethnicity, and sexual orientation. **Excluding all this vital data essentially renders vulnerable communities invisible in the eyes of the government. Undocumented immigrants, women, Black and Brown folks, and LGBTQ+ individuals would no longer appear in the data, and that means they would lose access to critical resources.** Eliminating data on the people you deem second-class is about as anti-democracy as you can get. The extremists in charge are doing everything in their power to rip away our healthcare and undermine our systems. They think they can get away with it because everyday people don’t hear much about the Census. That’s why these public comments are so vital—**we need to let them know that We the People know what they’re doing, and we won’t stand for it.** [**Click here to support our partners at Planned Parenthood in demanding a fair and accurate Census, that makes sure ALL of our communities count and get the resources we need.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMde6E5U0L3Jog5zF97H78Eohs3suca2qXQIOWnPdxwvZKSFTp5p4zujEhrA8L0brOrZWWqqPGzTlfKEIDE9kBBLbduX98E_vGV-VOpsg_Vj6HMKm76_wtGuHSgtO2dld2c5trCHyZoVa_mWgV8OrO8VkbyMvZ1LgOHugi2i4JWBfygefiN76FO6AXSJwZVrX0a1N_7-GvaoQeDCa2k59-471TZwQ1S4miniPiPRiOhcfu68t3FmeR9m35dUvm_OIpkzEWa8RLHsDgVrmL7L8tX5_jtDUUlkiOeHUyyLBaiAwN4i9Wt84Zd73fgirO5BSBtbGf77AkL6imDO-ebAIm7sqpSXu7sFWboYOqVmLuJJM/4v2/RfnoNdX0QhySzUQ17ljI9Q/h2/h001.axgY5vh4wnWW1-WvT0RAZRNBoXpZi9mgWBBGGwofXrk) Thank you for fighting for our rights, Morgan Stahr

Hi team,
**Last night 's debate made the contrast clear: Dan Meuser's in it for himself. I'll fight for us.**
Dan used his time to call me a socialist, lie, and blame everyone but himself for the problems we're facing.
I used my time to hold him accountable and talk about how we can actually make life better for our part of PA.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/789ee0d8-9202-4b25-bd05-4ca310f296c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

I asked Dan directly what he's done for _our_ bottom lines. He did not like that at all.
He was angry from his opening statement to his closing remarks. Everyone who watched saw exactly why he hides from the voters and doesn't hold town halls: **He cannot handle having to answer for his record.**
[ FIRE DAN MEUSER](https://substack.com/redirect/789ee0d8-9202-4b25-bd05-4ca310f296c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Dan thinks he can evade accountability by convincing us that we're divided and solutions aren't possible. But he's wrong. Our part of PA is done being taken for granted.
**It 's time to send someone who fights for us to Congress.**
We've got 13 days to get it done. Last night gave us a lot of momentum, but we have to keep it going. We need to get our message to everyone who didn't see the debate and get everyone who did watch it to the polls.
**[Can I count on you to chip in today?](https://substack.com/redirect/789ee0d8-9202-4b25-bd05-4ca310f296c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thank you,
Rachel Wallace

I'll fight for us. Dan used his time to call me a socialist, lie, and blame everyone but himself for the problems we're facing. I used my time to hold him accountable and talk about how we can actually make life better for our part of PA. | | ---|---|--- I asked Dan directly what he's done for our bottom lines. He did not like that at all. He was angry from his opening statement to his closing remarks. Everyone who watched saw exactly why he hides from the voters and doesn't hold town halls: He cannot handle having to answer for his record. Dan thinks he can evade accountability by convincing us that we're divided and solutions aren't possible. But he's wrong. Our part of PA is done being taken for granted. It 's time to send someone who fights for us to Congress. We've got 13 days to get it done. Last night gave us a lot of momentum, but we have to keep it going. We need to get our message to everyone who didn't see the debate and get everyone who did watch it to the polls. Thank you, Rachel Wallace Thanks for reading! Fetherston describes a voter who told him to meet him in the street, his exchange with Safiya Khalid, and translators assisting voters, many of whom he says also registered the same day. Robinson walks through how illegal Chinese-run marijuana grows use the hemp loophole to sell out of state. The panel also asks why Troy Jackson was absent from a campaign event and plays an ad from Minnesota secretary of state candidate Tad Jude.

body:
There’s no other way to say it.
# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=1149%2E127862%2EuymkhI)
Folks, there’s no other way to say it: **We’re being outspent 10 to 1.**
That’s a serious gap, and Nevada voters are casting their ballots _as you read this._
If we don’t work together to close the spending gap ASAP, undecided voters may not be able to hear from us before they cast their ballot.
**This is a make-or-break moment for our campaign. Because of that, I have a special ask for you:**
**[You’re a valued member of this campaign — and today, we’re asking if you can become a donor for the first time with just $2.50. Any amount will help us catch up before it’s too late.](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20261021_3_ak.Bdfla3&amount=2.50&refcode=em20261021-1134&t=3&akid=1149%2E127862%2EuymkhI)**
**[Donate $2.50 ››](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20261021_3_ak.Bdfla3&amount=2.50&refcode=em20261021-1134&t=22&akid=1149%2E127862%2EuymkhI)**
Unlike Lombardo, I don’t have a Rolodex of billionaire donors I can call and ask for a favor. I have you, and other members of our grassroots team to count on.
I wouldn’t have it any other way, but that doesn’t change the fact that our fundraising pace isn’t where it should be.
**Despite the massive GOP spending, this race is neck-and-neck.** Election forecasters say it, the polls show it, and I can feel it on the ground.
Truly, the factor that will matter most in determining who wins this is who can break through the noise and get their message across to as many Nevadans as possible before they vote.
**[With early voting already underway, the window to make an impact is closing fast. Help us get back in the fight by chipping in $2.50 or whatever you can afford today:](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20261021_3_ak.Bdfla3&amount=2.50&refcode=em20261021-1134&t=23&akid=1149%2E127862%2EuymkhI)**

Thank you,
Aaron

body:
For decades, Congress has failed to deliver on issues that most Americans agree deserve action. And frankly, it’s completely intentional.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141912495/655153032/777330224?refcode=email-logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDcvMS8xMDU4MjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGIzMzkwNTMtOWZjZC1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=px4kbcPCU1S4Hr6JP1smhOOzNZge-YcjNpdwYaAiAuY=) Do you know that old saying, “If you want something done right, do it yourself?” Well, Washington seems determined to test that theory. For decades, Congress has failed to deliver even on issues that most Americans agree deserve action. And frankly, it’s completely intentional. Banning members of Congress from trading stocks. Common-sense legislation to curb gun violence. A minimum wage more than a pathetic $7.25 an hour. Different issues, same story: The people want progress. Washington gets stuck. And somehow, the people who sent their representatives there are the ones left waiting. **So I’m doing something about it: I just introduced the Direct Democracy Amendment — a brand new constitutional amendment that would give American voters the power to pass or repeal federal laws when Congress fails to act.** [I’ll dig into the details in a moment, but if that’s all you need to hear, will you sign your name and become one of the very first Community Cosponsors of my Direct Democracy Amendment?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141912498/655153036/302056575?refcode=email_102126_amendmentRR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDcvMS8xMDU4MjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGIzMzkwNTMtOWZjZC1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=px4kbcPCU1S4Hr6JP1smhOOzNZge-YcjNpdwYaAiAuY=&emci=48339053-9fcd-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=4b339053-9fcd-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=6967550) | | [Sign Your Name →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141912503/655153040/302056575?refcode=email_102126_amendmentRR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDcvMS8xMDU4MjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGIzMzkwNTMtOWZjZC1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=px4kbcPCU1S4Hr6JP1smhOOzNZge-YcjNpdwYaAiAuY=&emci=48339053-9fcd-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=4b339053-9fcd-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=6967550)

Here’s how it works:
When Congress fails to act on an issue with widespread public support, every American will have the right to draft a federal ballot proposal.
The next step is to gather signatures. _A lot of them._ At least 5% of voters who participated in the last presidential election in at least 25 states. That’s a high bar — and it’s that way for a reason. A proposal would need broad, nationwide support to move forward.
Once those signatures are independently verified, it’s placed on the ballot of the next eligible national election. And if it earns at least 60% of the popular vote, it becomes law — _no Congressional vote or Presidential signature required._
**Direct democracy works. Heck, it’s worked right here in the U.S. for years! Today, 24 states have some form of statewide ballot initiative process — my amendment would just bring it to the national level.**
This amendment would give the people a meaningful say in their government — especially when powerful interests have money, lobbyists, and connections to keep the doors closed.
But if we turn the Direct Democracy Amendment into reality? **Things change._Quickly._**
[Washington has spent long enough telling Americans to wait for the next election for action. It’s time to give the people a seat at the table. Please, will you sign your name and become one of the very first Community Cosponsors of my Direct Democracy Amendment?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141912506/655153043/302056575?refcode=email_102126_amendmentRR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDcvMS8xMDU4MjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGIzMzkwNTMtOWZjZC1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=px4kbcPCU1S4Hr6JP1smhOOzNZge-YcjNpdwYaAiAuY=&emci=48339053-9fcd-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=4b339053-9fcd-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=6967550)

Yesterday, [Newsweek published my piece about Mitch McConnell's legacy.](https://substack.com/redirect/6dc7f9f4-e833-4002-8cb7-e54ccb77182d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Mitch has been my Senator my entire life. When he disappeared from the Senate for 90 days without explanation, I was frustrated - he's voted against paid sick leave, while receiving the best taxpayer-funded healthcare this country has to offer.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f302c95f-296d-4a9d-85c6-a1da9fe370a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But more than anything, I was heartbroken for the Kentuckians who needed his leadership during this cost-of-living crisis.
Instead of resigning and allowing a Senator fit to serve to step in, Mitch has clung to power for every last second to rubber-stamp Trump's agenda in Kentucky.
**And my opponent, Andy Barr, is already recycling Mitch 's playbook. He skipped our first debate, he voted "yes" on Trump's Big Beautiful Bill, and spends more time calling corporate and billionaire donors for campaign donations than talking to Kentuckians on the campaign trail.**
We've been duped into believing we have to settle for this, simply because that's the way it's been in Kentucky for the past four decades.
We don't need another Senator who puts power, wealth, and donors first. That may be Mitch and Andy's track record, but it does not have to be our future.
**We need a Senator who puts Kentucky first.**
If you're ready for a Senator who only answers to you, please chip in $25 or whatever you can spare right now.
[Chip in to support my Senate Campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/f302c95f-296d-4a9d-85c6-a1da9fe370a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Make a recurring donation](https://substack.com/redirect/c2019de6-c67a-4620-82fa-8ed3560cb7ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
_- Charles Booker_

Patriot, Let me explain why I'm so fired up about ballot chasing -- because the math is beautiful. Bank 20,000 votes early, and the path to victory gets dramatically easier. And study after study shows there's nothing more effective than a knock on the door. anti-abortion Republican extremists.

subject: Tell your state legislators to deliver paid parental leave
body:
Working families organized and won in Allegheny County. Let’s carry that momentum into every state capital and defend the progress we’ve made. | |
---
Peter, **We organized alongside nurses, parents, union members, and community allies to demand paid parental leave in Allegheny County. Now, we’ve won.** The County Council has voted 11-4 to approve paid parental leave, bringing us closer to a future where welcoming a child comes with time to heal and care, with a paycheck families can count on. We were grateful to work closely with PA United, SEIU, and many other groups. Through our coalition, we brought the experiences of working families into the fight. We know what it means to have rent coming due, groceries getting more expensive, and a newborn who needs us. We know how quickly unpaid time away from work can turn into missed bills and mounting debt. We also know the corporate opposition we’re up against. Business interests pushed back against requiring paid leave while working parents carried the cost of going without it. We kept organizing because our families’ health and economic security deserve protections employers are required to respect. **Now, we’re taking that momentum to every state capital. Here in Pennsylvania, we need legislators to deliver paid leave statewide. Across the country, we need lawmakers to pass strong protections and defend the laws our movements have already won.** [**Tell your state legislators to guarantee paid parental leave and protect working families from corporate efforts to weaken it.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39t8AKSi0kWg0TfGmcaPg3LzRSyW2fsW0ZMVXksOjT7An2aAk0gw9AlpSBzUa3z_GoMFBiErYKeYK5sjXwSTBXEZrOa4o8hQmIc3wHrVmKifKLHt9Awc327OP7nnxhrxJVY8eDpbTr-ruQq_T__ohm26hEaK-CSaghiUZwqLIQA0vnNnNRfX1ngAgb8hgUYMp7NJMCOLn8vknKJZ1BfanqdcdoHcNO_dpcs21ZbLcKCFTmMPHOZPwJjxpv4Q3_0RyVrNZYv04ADlS7EO9AQokKizGNQOPvedJD0R2t6emlnR7xr88KFp6MkXyOnp1nNkxSkp-171rbpoHDkewbc4DL55uHZG_KkurqNwa8z5oXqpCgPcmj-QgyMjBnRVt_ZfYE/4v2/l-UHfkj0QA-mVj-VKLZpJA/h0/h001.BSDxESRGxQOdvpKQshCIYX-G6T-PMDKU-GfjNfvH1-M) | | [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39t8AKSi0kWg0TfGmcaPg3LzRSyW2fsW0ZMVXksOjT7AvGWMxQGJHMHB9o6pHcHyxMAHZMck-7ZgcbaVB7MRrYWw5Qv4F8hcr6Jw1Z4IEJ1QZB-sJHFw4Aak5I6j9XwJRCevUiOpyj3NlEO111UoCWEsCCHgS-X0YPYIlnlHRsH-77_GyFF3LVZMyWWZESDwthySh9oUZMWwnFrAXM-wZwLlYVTsaQKns5PvzEwpQNmjOMQcl6ZkCK71V_ceVsJlf04onnmUDYhr3hvPv6z4ZigDmyjiU9lLR5CYow_MXkBDZuZN5l4DmnNpjUwD6c9ONVVgWwYprR5KsUXOicbmZ2TafMhpI6FWCv39zx8dtNOezzrT5LtANC4aBi5hPsNKuM/4v2/l-UHfkj0QA-mVj-VKLZpJA/h1/h001.Ikf3BSJBLpBc8TkD59F4KJyz6EOj7bmKR4AqvyYv8_Y)

**We’re fighting for time to recover from childbirth, bond with a new child, and adjust to the demands of parenthood without losing the income that keeps our families housed and fed.** We need paid leave that parents can actually afford to take, backed by protections against retaliation.
For us, this is also a fight for racial and economic justice. Black families and workers in low-wage jobs face barriers to paid leave alongside deep inequities in maternal and infant health. We’re organizing to make sure the parents facing the greatest financial pressure can get the support they need.
We’ve already seen movements win comprehensive paid family and medical leave laws in 14 states and Washington, D.C. Wherever we’ve won, we have to protect those gains against benefit cuts, corporate carveouts, and efforts to delay implementation. Wherever families remain unprotected, we have to keep building the power to change the law.
At OnePA, we build that power by bringing our neighbors together, developing leaders, and holding elected officials accountable to the communities they serve. **We won this step forward through organizing. Let’s turn it into momentum for working families everywhere.**

clean_body: Working families organized and won in Allegheny County. Let’s carry that momentum into every state capital and defend the progress we’ve made. | | Peter, We organized alongside nurses, parents, union members, and community allies to demand paid parental leave in Allegheny County. Now, we’ve won. The County Council has voted 11-4 to approve paid parental leave, bringing us closer to a future where welcoming a child comes with time to heal and care, with a paycheck families can count on. We were grateful to work closely with PA United, SEIU, and many other groups. Through our coalition, we brought the experiences of working families into the fight. We know what it means to have rent coming due, groceries getting more expensive, and a newborn who needs us. We know how quickly unpaid time away from work can turn into missed bills and mounting debt. We also know the corporate opposition we’re up against. Business interests pushed back against requiring paid leave while working parents carried the cost of going without it. We kept organizing because our families’ health and economic security deserve protections employers are required to respect. Now, we’re taking that momentum to every state capital. Here in Pennsylvania, we need legislators to deliver paid leave statewide. Across the country, we need lawmakers to pass strong protections and defend the laws our movements have already won. | | We’re fighting for time to recover from childbirth, bond with a new child, and adjust to the demands of parenthood without losing the income that keeps our families housed and fed. We need paid leave that parents can actually afford to take, backed by protections against retaliation. For us, this is also a fight for racial and economic justice. Black families and workers in low-wage jobs face barriers to paid leave alongside deep inequities in maternal and infant health. We’re organizing to make sure the parents facing the greatest financial pressure can get the support they need. We’ve already seen movements win comprehensive paid family and medical leave laws in 14 states and Washington, D.C. Wherever we’ve won, we have to protect those gains against benefit cuts, corporate carveouts, and efforts to delay implementation. Wherever families remain unprotected, we have to keep building the power to change the law. At OnePA, we build that power by bringing our neighbors together, developing leaders, and holding elected officials accountable to the communities they serve. We won this step forward through organizing. Let’s turn it into momentum for working families everywhere. Hi Peter,

As election day nears, James Talarico is letting his "moderate" mask slip.

When asked at a recent campaign event who his favorite drag queen was, he didn't miss a beat - instantly rattling "their" name off like he'd been asked his favorite color.

That video has gone viral online, racking up millions of views on social media.

Talarico has spent this entire campaign trying to sell Texas voters on a moderate, Bible-quoting version of himself, and videos like this are the LAST thing Talarico's campaign wants getting out to Texas voters.

Texas voters outside Austin won't buy his facade, not once they see the real Talarico instead of the campaign-trail version.

And right now in Michigan, Democrat U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is running the same playbook, holding town halls in Lansing, Grand Rapids, Detroit, Flint, and Macomb, hoping moderate suburban voters forget he wants abortion legal through all nine months.

My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I'm the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement.

Peter, here's my problem.

You and I can't rely on the national media to tell the truth about these politicians' abortion extremism.

So it's up to grassroots folks like you and me to hold them accountable.
That's exactly what I want to do with my rapid response counter-protests at as many candidate events as possible in our targeted races.

[Will you please chip in right now to keep our rapid response team ready to move the moment we get word of the next public event](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=23f2d6cbf91740218f40584978b7f8c7&_e=oYxKePg9jDGfChKtsz9qB1XFk785SKDj3EmfvrPxoNvY7W-4P6XdV6Ry5prI5eCjmqRA0KrM-voqsQp1YCeDp7KQtOpByZEnSsPqGXSplK12-CV6ApcZitN8IJgGPhwrvOkvBvpDTLjbpTeMJjT0vsdWiqlDBxr2e8StNt7xofYzwSa0NBRkGKCM_5IPoYfAbmadpB_DI9-DdK9Qc9eQC6f32Dxm8091a3UsL3m7hb43Pl5-td3Byzd_F5ogdwpyH7-HMt6GtV_mLy2k7DhJn3CveTeUzlA1Z-qMhscG5Y2hxuifGOB7faxeAWkU8p9u4XpADq5ul-kYQYzoTk4LYS8y51snyNVBCma34eMQn5Mh5cz20t5mjdEevBVTTgwFMgE14KkH7579hbNOp8fyYTRBKStBtS3MvtFSJXPVxTKetqqttjWUlSo8ZNyXkCLmOqQ2HCaXbrhtBZaOfPG86Z-uqHGvJxJws86OQ-xKQZsmSY2Y1f-P0zDO_VtPEb-lNuZdZKGm6l0Qj2W-RwgT4MA5xjsIMpofZHaIt8l2okCOEeJ6RzFdf8imjSxUVlS0hxp6cW6cdOCl0uArTz5fRmkx6Ki6uu-pASi2t5B54-G8P7nCVMf8vT2ftsVvKtbnP2a1tuvsc_16m0d-wnOaoA%3D%3D)**?**

Last month, our Pro-Life Generation activists launched the first stop of a 100-church flyering campaign at a church right in Talarico's back yard.

Then, when he spoke at Baylor University - a Baptist school - our team was on the ground to ensure attendees heard the truth about his anti-Biblical, pro-abortion stance.

Do you remember, back in 2024, when our students walked into a Kamala Harris rally in Wisconsin, held up a cross, and got mocked from the stage for it?

A video went viral of Kamala on stage, talking about abortion "rights" and overturning Roe v. Wade, denouncing Christians who said "Christ is King," and responding to our students with "You guys are at the wrong rally."

I've seen it time and time again.

These are exactly the moments on the campaign trail that can swing an entire election.

One month from today, on Tuesday, November 3rd, voters across the nation will decide who controls Congress for the next two years - and who has the momentum heading into the critical 2028 presidential cycle.

Talarico, El-Sayed, and all pro-abortion politicians know a camera catching them off-script is worth more than any ad buy. That's exactly why they're not publishing their schedules more than a day or two out.

So my team has to be ready before they announce, not after.

That means canvassers who can redirect on short notice and students who'll show up with signs and cameras of their own.

None of that comes free, and none of it waits for a fundraising deadline.

[Peter, will you please make your most generous contribution to keep Students for Life Action ready to move the second one of these campaigns tips their hand](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=23f2d6cbf91740218f40584978b7f8c7&_e=oYxKePg9jDGfChKtsz9qB1XFk785SKDj3EmfvrPxoNvY7W-4P6XdV6Ry5prI5eCjmqRA0KrM-voqsQp1YCeDp7KQtOpByZEnSsPqGXSplK12-CV6ApcZitN8IJgGPhwrvOkvBvpDTLjbpTeMJjT0vsdWiqlDBxr2e8StNt7xofb6jvJXI5Wf0kxtq4-tOCvTWbZdCjM_OrfIikl_oa5UBYQvGumyDtnNEB0fZJ3nhFJ1_Z_Lpdutnhw_9NXSq8ebTm6CW7KMhcSLI4pB4wwdhmbpOGDhEAF6BT0Kpg9NNyuoTPYOd1AgFcXwDJkwqdJKqBCj2sImC8RU4kCRHtwA4Ju7kNL9Kjjt8QBGYGasdCbOXKDCm81Ve0cdmg6Qbry4Q_9OTJ2bZkEDbd-ap4kswPIvki7OwLeJwK9Z3oGDmlh1Zlscaeu9GWVgvTkNhvkZQeqy_-LPtDUO2U0jSIG9E0wty9YAqz7iZQ8gLUAH6mTyueiQpVAx_yHF9L1d32mo1U5rJTiyER8NwwbdxD18XmBuhtz_fDmZB8Yfqii7oXs-8vqNHkWLY60iNhby4kDUKSz3ZKt4eSBwK3eO-2sEVETWlHlCPBWbVmmlbhuoBVxZiAcn3zjSow79n8NjWv7Gefwc_FKTtckWUDDxWlxN2A%3D%3D)**?**

clean_body: Hi Peter, As election day nears, James Talarico is letting his "moderate" mask slip. When asked at a recent campaign event who his favorite drag queen was, he didn't miss a beat - instantly rattling "their" name off like he'd been asked his favorite color. That video has gone viral online, racking up millions of views on social media. Talarico has spent this entire campaign trying to sell Texas voters on a moderate, Bible-quoting version of himself, and videos like this are the LAST thing Talarico's campaign wants getting out to Texas voters. Texas voters outside Austin won't buy his facade, not once they see the real Talarico instead of the campaign-trail version. And right now in Michigan, Democrat U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is running the same playbook, holding town halls in Lansing, Grand Rapids, Detroit, Flint, and Macomb, hoping moderate suburban voters forget he wants abortion legal through all nine months. My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I'm the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement. Peter, here's my problem. You and I can't rely on the national media to tell the truth about these politicians' abortion extremism. So it's up to grassroots folks like you and me to hold them accountable. That's exactly what I want to do with my rapid response counter-protests at as many candidate events as possible in our targeted races. ? Last month, our Pro-Life Generation activists launched the first stop of a 100-church flyering campaign at a church right in Talarico's back yard. Then, when he spoke at Baylor University - a Baptist school - our team was on the ground to ensure attendees heard the truth about his anti-Biblical, pro-abortion stance. Do you remember, back in 2024, when our students walked into a Kamala Harris rally in Wisconsin, held up a cross, and got mocked from the stage for it? A video went viral of Kamala on stage, talking about abortion "rights" and overturning Roe v. Wade, denouncing Christians who said "Christ is King," and responding to our students with "You guys are at the wrong rally." I've seen it time and time again. These are exactly the moments on the campaign trail that can swing an entire election. One month from today, on Tuesday, November 3rd, voters across the nation will decide who controls Congress for the next two years - and who has the momentum heading into the critical 2028 presidential cycle. Talarico, El-Sayed, and all pro-abortion politicians know a camera catching them off-script is worth more than any ad buy. That's exactly why they're not publishing their schedules more than a day or two out. So my team has to be ready before they announce, not after. That means canvassers who can redirect on short notice and students who'll show up with signs and cameras of their own. None of that comes free, and none of it waits for a fundraising deadline. ? It’s Chris.
I need to be direct
with you about where this race stands and why the next 8 days matter so
much.

Unlike most other competitive states, New Hampshire doesn’t have early
voting. In the last election, about 9 in 10 Granite Staters cast their
ballots on Election Day. So while voters elsewhere are already casting
ballots, the vast majority here are still making up their minds.

And right now here’s what they’re seeing on TV:

Attack ad after attack ad. John Sununu and the flood of GOP outside money
propping him up have outspent us 3:1. We can go head-to-head with them,
but we’re up against a hard deadline.

October 29th is the last day to expand our TV buys. After that what voters
see on their screens in the final stretch is locked in.

That’s why our team set a goal of raising $500,000 before the October 29th
deadline. Our ability to expand our TV buys in the final stretch depends
on cash on hand.

If you haven’t made a donation to our campaign yet, there isn’t a moment
when your first contribution matters more. This seat is how we keep New
Hampshire blue and take back the Senate majority.

Hey, it's Troy Jackson. I'm proud to support my friend, Amy Acton, in her race for Governor of Ohio. I'm passing along her note to you because it's powerful -- and then, I'm going to ask you to **[chip in to support our campaigns.](https://substack.com/redirect/907b46db-3ea6-4f6a-ab35-0419881c0629?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* * *
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/907b46db-3ea6-4f6a-ab35-0419881c0629?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Hey -- it's Amy.

My decision to email you today wasn't an easy one -- but I don't want to wake up on November 4th wondering if one more email could have tipped the scales.

Because that's how close this race is.

**Experts have said our race for governor is one of the most competitive in the entire country.**

Right now, we're facing a significant budget gap -- and it means we're at risk of having to pull the plug on some of our TV ads, just 13 days before the election...

**My finance team pulled the numbers, and if everyone reading this email chipped in $8 or more -- we'd be able to keep our ads on air.**

_With Vivek Ramaswamy and his allies pouring in $145 MILLION to their TV ads, and outspending us seven to one, this would be the WORST possible time to have to go dark._

**[That's why I decided to reach out to you today. I know you aren't an ATM, but frankly, I have nowhere else to turn. I'm urgently asking my top supporters to chip in $8 or more to me and Troy Jackson in the next 30 minutes to help us show Vivek Ramaswamy and his billionaire allies the sheer strength of this grassroots campaign.](https://substack.com/redirect/497728c8-fef5-443e-8d13-9131d3370d8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[CONTRIBUTE ->](https://substack.com/redirect/497728c8-fef5-443e-8d13-9131d3370d8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you for listening,

Amy

Because every state gets 2 senators regardless of population, a voter in Nebraska has far more Senate representation per person than a voter in Texas, Florida, Michigan, or Georgia. There are roughly 2 million people in Nebraska, compared with more than 30 million in Texas, 24 million in Florida, and more than 10 million in Michigan and Georgia. Put simply, your donation goes 16 times as far in Nebraska as it would in Texas. That’s why this opportunity to defeat a Republican Senator in Nebraska is so exciting, and it’s why your dollar goes so much further here than it would in a bigger state. # PRESS RELEASE

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
October 21, 2026

**CONTACT**
Todd Cheewing
Todd@Ascent-Strategic.com

**IN CASE YOU MISSED IT: LILY TANG WILLIAMS WON THE NEW ENGLAND COLLEGE DEBATE**

WEARE, NH — Republican congressional nominee Lily Tang Williams declared victory following Tuesday’s New England College debate, contrasting her commitment to affordability, accountability, and the American Dream with Congresswoman Maggie Goodlander’s Washington record. “Granite Staters deserve results, not excuses from career politicians,” said Williams. “Maggie Goodlander has had her chance in Congress, yet families are still struggling to afford groceries, housing, and home heating. I’m running to put Granite Staters first, not Washington party bosses.” Williams highlighted her journey from communist China to becoming an American entrepreneur, contrasting her firsthand experience with economic hardship against Goodlander’s privileged upbringing and support for the Biden Administration’s failed legacy of higher costs. “I know what it means to struggle and build a life from nothing,” Williams added. “Maggie Goodlander talks about affordability. I’ve lived it. And I’ll never forget who I work for.” With Election Day less than two weeks away, Williams framed the choice as Washington’s status quo versus an independent voice fighting for New Hampshire families.
**About Lily Tang Williams**
Born in China just before Mao’s Cultural Revolution to working-class parents, Lily Tang Williams immigrated to the United States with nothing and built a life as an entrepreneur, educator, and community leader in Weare, NH. A living embodiment of the American Dream, she brings a uniquely powerful perspective to the fight for freedom and limited government.

In 2024, Williams won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against current incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in more than a decade to flipping NH-02. She is back and running stronger than ever in 2026.

→ Trying to force the U.S. Postal Service to become an election regulation hub and _reject mail-in ballots that are not postmarked by Election Day._
And those are just **two examples** of how Trump has tried to completely transform our election system in his favor.

clean_body: I’m humbly asking for your support. | Peter, I wanted to reach out to you personally because we’re coming up on our end-of-month deadline — and we’re still short of where we need to be with not much time left. Service has always been at the center of my life. I enlisted in the Marine Corps at 18, trained at Camp Pendleton, and served overseas before being honorably discharged as a Sergeant. Since then, I’ve continued serving my community—as a small business owner, a city council member, and a father committed to building a safer, stronger future. | After my time in the Marines, I built a business from the ground up. I know the long hours, the risks, and the sacrifices it takes to succeed— and I believe Washington should be making it easier, not harder, for hardworking Americans to get ahead. My decision to run for office was also deeply personal. After losing my son, I made a promise to fight for safer communities and uphold the rule of law so no other family has to experience that kind of tragedy. That’s what I’m fighting for— If you’re able, Every dollar helps us stay on track and continue fighting for the values we believe in—public safety, economic opportunity, and accountable government. Friend,
---
Charlie said it best in the days leading up to President Trump's victory in 2024: _" I don't care about polls. __ __I don 't care about betting markets. __ __I don 't care about vibes. __ _ **_I care about how many ballots are in the box. _**_ __If we turnout, we win. __ _**_Do the work. " _** Do the work... Charlie knew there was no easy route to saving our country. He knew there were no shortcuts to victory. He wore a red band on his wrist every day -- a reminder of what it would take -- that read, _**" Be Better. Work Harder." **_ It wasn't just for motivation. Charlie lived by those four words, and he expected every one of us at Turning Point to live by them too. In fact, the standards that Charlie built this movement on still hang on the walls inside our headquarters:
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=b8500a04584544c2900299699676aa35&_e=L1X-K8Vxao6mrPKWwS6CQzEoM6Nyc8Lx3wudokmfeEbxq_cwNdGW5SMrRpQoTh3xT5IVTzQyrpfuhMpdsFWfQ0tjZXVlK7mqsjkfBc-kr9dq2gRUJZuA-iPCuCtL5iUdIn9cmlmBggk2GVU4eTcWhI9q2CTzLzcWX5t09MZ-cMhsxyCqTYO8aCgog9biIVlJEmqht8KtDGTcTiw9HWAB6Amuo_nyHFJ3TOctaKwPV-ZZlWA5R527HcbFcnqHwvmBlPSZ1rtt2KPHzo79kmnh8LwCsa0kh22ch-opu6Y0SV0lpUH0ufxVbPI3-M-JldvGTYOSWZJD1kGFdYDKUaSRmLojLN62EZ_7SuFMh2otAlncledppeDi-ojA3Yrr_ui9Og8OkPcFEPSBMBHaj-geJ6h_EgFwQORXHmigpUpVVA-qLurXKXWD61ax-guRNHdyQxS2QipqunNvQvHPpOfUJAYyWxOMe8Em2t4Q9hECTWfI_kawbl_FjP2nNrqSEIBMbw7uwXH7v3hpbI9ClG-0__uhIY3igORnXTUntmjSQEfX_SxBDn_D40UsM0Idmuvy3qiY3s3moXsTivldjggWPNxqt2BKM1Br_0Tlt0YZvlsuS7tWQuXnr8UWpQXYMvnybnri4CiLa3Mc4rEcBPZfNAL3lZCcECA4ttUs-_7fQOvIqo8HIGRVrvhhCgKscAM5Jf6lCBmhRwrAFsxA7kCQ0-M2Yq8gUBdW2a432oNQdM0%3D)
---
Those banners were never meant just for the people on our staff. Charlie meant them for anyone who ever said they'd fight for this country. And that includes patriots like you, Friend. Because right now, the midterms are coming down to the wire. _Nearly every battleground state or district? _ Tied. A dead heat. Within the margin of error. **And just as Charlie said... when it 's that close, only one thing matters: How. Many. Ballots. Are. In. The. Box. ** That's why our ballot chasing teams are working around the clock in Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire to beat the Communist Left this November.
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=b8500a04584544c2900299699676aa35&_e=L1X-K8Vxao6mrPKWwS6CQzEoM6Nyc8Lx3wudokmfeEbxq_cwNdGW5SMrRpQoTh3xT5IVTzQyrpfuhMpdsFWfQ0tjZXVlK7mqsjkfBc-kr9dq2gRUJZuA-iPCuCtL5iUdIn9cmlmBggk2GVU4eTcWhI9q2CTzLzcWX5t09MZ-cMhsxyCqTYO8aCgog9biIVlJEmqht8KtDGTcTiw9HWAB6Amuo_nyHFJ3TOctaKwPV-ZZlWA5R527HcbFcnqHwvmBdKdkukvI-fI6Eq4_UIPN1M5k6rwG9MTfB_oQK4eheT7V2feo7yDhnjOq5gZBSGhwdGlkrA6ZNlohupT7V-c2ffLa1HBtkm_V1SEmZIZ4TuOymuVGD3CgSBlyUVNsVjI1JjPvmsUTUcpZYpL4wTSyhK-G2PM4guuZLEms8QbmbAcLy2Smrrox7bRMM7b5g-7mq7Vms8TYRh4Uy-NTyrQ3PK8eKk-0B8p7lNutCt9dYkJezp0ykIzIleJThpKGdE-1MzP8ZrYTh5O7AzavlHw3j9-hYjNkSlbZlLB4lLW5sNWA783-X_ka_loBR-PxTPsPSvnyApTwiUoe4KYfFQyIqOf1KLdWU1b4PoRatwGUb0_k1ZxZPbcalTq0-htDoEJcm3j5NRcmgcOUvi8kRn_gjAtpZZ0_BOqTomvZsILbTNtj3WYtCVxmrhbXlkIkdCQuwvXs4cmDGSU0Ar6sZSLIq7eCt6xIqLv7Ft0Khr6n_Co%3D)
---
They're out knocking doors, making phone calls, registering voters, training new volunteers, and once voting opens, they'll chase down every last ballot they can. But as hard as they're working, we still don't have enough of them. clean_body: | = Peter — it's Amy. My decision to email you today wasn't an easy one — but I don't want to wake up on November 4 wondering if one more email could have tipped the scales. Because that's how close this race is, Peter. Experts have said our race for governor is one of the most competitive in the entire country. Right now, we're facing a significant budget gap — and it means we're at risk of having to pull the plug on some of our TV ads, just 13 days before the election... My finance team pulled the numbers, and if everyone reading this email chipped in $8 or more — we'd be able to keep our ads on air. She’s spent 25 years in public service, leading federal operations and earning two Department of Homeland Security Secretary’s Awards along the way. When she was directed to do something unethical, **she made the difficult decision to leave the career she loved rather than violate her oath to the constitution.**

This campaign, she’s shown up in every corner of the District, listening to anyone who walks through the door. In Congress, she’ll fight for good paying jobs, Medicaid/Medicare, social security benefits, healthcare close to home, and the land and water that makes this place ours.

Get out and vote - here’s how:
* **Vote early in person.** [Early voting is open now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141915545/655163265/-311190476?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjQ3MDYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTA5ZDA0ZWMtYWFjZC1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=QP87mhWn13WY8Vnj57kkh8I-xjJcuJ7YShtF6es-Vxg=&emci=84ff7459-a8cd-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=e09d04ec-aacd-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=1071883) through Monday, November 2nd. Your ballot goes straight into the ballot counter, just like on Election Day.
* **Voting by mail?** Your ballot must arrive by Election Day. A postmark isn’t enough. Mail it back right away, or drop it off at the election office that sent it by 5PM on November 3rd. If you vote by mail-in or absentee ballot, [track your ballot here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141915546/655163266/2119055919?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjQ3MDYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTA5ZDA0ZWMtYWFjZC1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=QP87mhWn13WY8Vnj57kkh8I-xjJcuJ7YShtF6es-Vxg=&emci=84ff7459-a8cd-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=e09d04ec-aacd-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=1071883).
* **Not registered yet?** You can still register when you vote. Just bring proof of where you live.
* **Prefer Election Day?** [Polls are open Tuesday, November 3rd](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141915547/655163267/1790631974?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjQ3MDYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTA5ZDA0ZWMtYWFjZC1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=QP87mhWn13WY8Vnj57kkh8I-xjJcuJ7YShtF6es-Vxg=&emci=84ff7459-a8cd-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=e09d04ec-aacd-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=1071883), until 8PM. Too much is still broken and it’s time to change course. She’s spent 25 years in public service, leading federal operations and earning two Department of Homeland Security Secretary’s Awards along the way. When she was directed to do something unethical, she made the difficult decision to leave the career she loved rather than violate her oath to the constitution. This campaign, she’s shown up in every corner of the District, listening to anyone who walks through the door. In Congress, she’ll fight for good paying jobs, Medicaid/Medicare, social security benefits, healthcare close to home, and the land and water that makes this place ours.
